title: Social Media Manager + Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Mocktail Magic is a growing U.S.-based premium mocktail and corporate events brand. We’re looking for a creative, reliable Social Media Manager + Short-Form Video Editor to help take ownership of our Instagram content and keep the brand consistently active.

Initial monthly scope:

• 8 short-form Reels

• 2 carousels

• Edit existing event/B-roll footage

• Create strong hooks, captions and on-screen text

• Create natural U.S.-English voiceovers when appropriate (AI is okay)

• Research trends, formats and relevant audio

• Schedule and publish content

• Basic engagement/community management

• Proactively suggest new content ideas

• Review performance and recommend what to create more/less of

Our audience is primarily B2B/corporate — HR, workplace experience teams, event planners, agencies and brands.

This is not just an editing role. I’m looking for someone who understands social media, storytelling, hooks and content strategy and can turn raw footage into fresh content without needing detailed instructions for every post.

Experience with CapCut, Canva, Instagram and AI content tools is preferred. Excellent written English and content that feels natural to a U.S. audience are important.

This starts as a 30-day paid trial at $600/month with the opportunity for a long-term role, increased compensation and expanded responsibilities if it’s a strong fit.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a small paid content test using real Mocktail Magic footage.

To apply:  

1. Send 3 examples of Reels/short-form videos you personally created.

2. Tell me which editing, design and AI tools you use.

3. Tell me about a social account you’ve managed and what you personally handled.

4. Tell me your current availability.

5. Start your application with MAGIC so I know you read the full post.

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor & Graphic Designer (Part-time Remote)
description:
PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR – UGC ADS



We’re looking for a performance-focused video editor to work with our e-commerce brand, SHAPSS.



This is more than just editing videos. We want someone who understands UGC ads, hooks, retention, pacing and creative testing — someone who can take existing footage and turn it into multiple ad variations so we can continuously test new angles and improve performance.



What you'll be doing:



Edit UGC videos for TikTok, Instagram and Meta ads

Create different hooks and openings from the same footage

Test different angles, messaging, pacing, captions and CTAs

Create multiple variations of winning concepts

Add captions, text overlays, B-roll, sound effects and cuts where appropriate

Work quickly on new creative iterations

Take feedback and make revisions quickly



We're looking for someone who:



Has experience editing UGC / DTC / performance ads

Understands what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching

Has a strong understanding of hooks and retention

Is confident using CapCut, Premiere Pro or After Effects

Has strong English and attention to detail

Is fast, reliable and organised

Can edit for performance, not just aesthetics



Experience with fashion, beauty, wellness or lifestyle brands is a bonus.



TRIAL TASK



We will provide you with raw UGC footage from SHAPSS.

title: GoHighLevel SEO + Website Optimization Specialist
description:
Mocktail Magic is a growing U.S.-based corporate events and mocktail experience company. Our website is built in GoHighLevel (GHL), and I'm looking for an experienced SEO + website optimization specialist to audit and improve our site.

I specifically need someone experienced with GoHighLevel websites/funnels who is also comfortable working with professional SEO platforms such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, GA4, Google PageSpeed Insights and Search Atlas/GHL SEO.

I already use SEO tools that are identifying errors and opportunities. I need someone who can interpret the data, determine what actually matters, prioritize the issues, and implement the fixes rather than simply sending automated reports.

Initial paid project: $150 SEO + website audit

Please evaluate:

- Technical SEO and site health

- GHL/Search Atlas audit findings

- Semrush/Ahrefs findings where applicable

- Google Search Console performance and indexing

- PageSpeed + Core Web Vitals

- Mobile performance

- Image/file optimization

- Scripts/code affecting performance

- Broken links, redirects and crawl issues

- Titles, meta descriptions and H1/H2 structure

- Internal linking

- Schema/structured data

- Keyword rankings and opportunities

- Existing service/location pages

- Local SEO

- Backlink profile/opportunities

- Competitor SEO

- GA4/tracking

- Conversion/UX issues affecting leads

Your audit must clearly show:

1. What is wrong or could be improved

2. Evidence/data supporting it

3. Priority: High / Medium / Low

4. Recommended solution

5. What you can personally implement inside GHL

This is not an AI blog-writing or automated SEO-reporting position. I want someone who understands the tools but also has the judgment to determine which recommendations are worth implementing.

If the audit is strong, the next phase will be a paid implementation project to fix the identified issues, followed by potential ongoing SEO work.

To apply:

1. Start your application with GHLSEO

2. Send examples of GHL websites you've optimized

3. Describe your specific GoHighLevel SEO experience

4. List the SEO tools you actively use and your experience with Semrush, Ahrefs, Search Atlas, GSC and GA4

5. Send an example technical/SEO audit if available

6. Tell me the first 3 things you check when a GHL website has poor organic visibility/performance

7. Tell me which SEO fixes you can implement yourself directly in GHL

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate & Community Lead (PowerTools) - Full Time, Remote
description:
We are building one of the biggest and best power tools brands in the world, and we need a relentless operator to build, scale, and mobilize our creator army. You will own affiliate recruitment, rapid-fire testing, and community development across TikTok Shop and volume funnels like Growee, turning creator outreach into a scalable revenue machine.

This role balances operational numbers with high-touch relationship building. You will run our creator network like a scientific testing lab: spotting trends early, driving high-volume experimentation, and turning breakout creators into long-term brand partners.



What You Will Do

-Build & Scale the Creator Army: Source, recruit, and onboard creators via TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace and volume funnels like Growee.

-Run the Testing Engine: Use Calodata and market intel weekly to analyze viral video formats, trending products, and competitor hooks. Translate those insights into fast, executable testing briefs for affiliates.

-Activate & Seed: Qualify product testers, coordinate sample distribution, and drive high activation rates to ensure seeded products turn into posted videos.

-Nurture Top Performers: Identify high-converting creators and negotiate custom deals, tiered commissions, and exclusive partnerships to scale sustainable GMV.

-Drive Core KPIs: Obsess over affiliate activation rate, weekly video output volume, ROAS, and monthly GMV growth.





What We Are Looking For

-Direct experience running or aggressively scaling a TikTok Shop affiliate program.

-Hands-on proficiency with volume outreach platforms (Growee or similar) and TikTok data analytics software (Calodata).

-Strong analytical ability to separate signal from noise and double down on winning content angles quickly.

-Exceptional communication skills with the ability to motivate, lead, and energize an external creator community.

-An autonomous builder who thrives with high ownership, rapid iteration, and zero hand-holding.



The Opportunity & Culture

This is a ground-floor role with high-trajectory upside. You will have direct access to executive mentorship, dedicated leadership training, and the proven playbooks we have used to scale sister brands within Orca Brands. Your compensation, salary growth, and performance bonuses will directly reflect the results you drive.

We hire strictly for cultural alignment with the core values of Orca Brands:

-Team Player: Mission-first, collaborative, and low ego.

-Speed & Urgency: High bias for action; moves fast and tests without hesitation.

Know more About Us:

description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

title: AI AGENT DEVELOPER & AUTOMATION SPECIALIST
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Agent Developer & Automation Specialist who can turn business methodologies, marketing frameworks, and internal processes into reliable AI-powered tools and workflows.



This is not an AI research or analyst position. We need a hands-on builder who can understand a business objective, design the appropriate AI workflow, build and test the solution, and explain how the tool should be used.



Key Responsibilities:



-Design and build custom AI agents using platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, or other relevant AI tools.

-Convert business frameworks, marketing methodologies, and standard operating procedures into guided AI workflows.

-Create AI tools that collect structured information and produce useful, consistent outputs.

-Develop AI-supported tools for landing pages, messaging, content planning, campaign development, research, and internal operations.

-Build reusable prompt systems, knowledge bases, and structured agent instructions.

-Connect AI tools with CRMs, forms, databases, project-management systems, or automation platforms when needed.

-Use tools such as Zapier, Make, APIs, or webhooks to automate workflows.

-Test outputs for accuracy, consistency, usability, brand alignment, and potential hallucinations.

-Improve existing prompts and workflows based on user feedback and performance.

-Establish appropriate human-review steps and safeguards.

-Document the architecture, prompts, workflows, limitations, and maintenance requirements.

-Train team members on the proper use of completed AI tools.

-Manage assigned development projects, timelines, testing, and implementation.



What We’re Looking For:



-Demonstrated experience building functional AI agents, assistants, or automated AI workflows.

-Hands-on experience with ChatGPT, Claude, custom GPTs, APIs, or comparable platforms.

-Ability to turn a business framework or methodology into a structured and usable AI tool.

-Previous experience working in a corporate environment, established agency, technology team, or similarly structured organization.

-Experience managing technical projects, leading implementations, or coordinating cross-functional team members.

-Strong understanding of prompt architecture, context management, knowledge bases, testing, and output evaluation.

-Ability to identify where AI is useful—and where human review must remain part of the process.

-Strong documentation, communication, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

-Ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical founders and team members.

-Proactive approach to recommending appropriate tools and implementation methods.



Preferred Experience:

-Experience with Claude Projects, custom GPTs, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or agent-building platforms.

-Familiarity with Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

-Experience connecting AI tools with GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, Notion, Airtable, or project-management platforms.

-Experience developing AI tools for marketing, sales, content, consulting, coaching, or professional-services businesses.

-Familiarity with privacy, data security, intellectual-property considerations, and responsible AI implementation.



Work Arrangement:

-Part-time independent contractor position

-Must be responsive during agreed working hours for collaboration, testing, feedback, and implementation

-Open to Filipino applicants currently based in the Philippines

Assist with system implementations, upgrades, integrations, and data migration projects.

Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting best practices.

Experience with consolidations, fund accounting, and multi-entity accounting structures preferred.

Experience with RAMP, Kyriba, or similar accounting, treasury, and reporting platforms is preferred.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across all levels of the organization.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience in private credit, real estate debt, alternative investments, or asset management industries preferred.

title: After-hours Staffing Coordinator
description:
Position Type: After-Hours / Staffing Coordination

Time Zone: Pacific Time

Open Positions: 1

Start Date: Immediate — for the right candidate



Position Overview



We are seeking a dependable, organized, and highly communicative After-Hours Staffing Coordinator to support our staffing operations outside of standard business hours.



This position is available to start immediately for the right candidate.



In this role, you will oversee after-hours staffing operations, address urgent scheduling needs, support caregivers and clients, and help ensure continuity of care when the regular office is closed.



Because this position requires frequent communication by phone, clear, fluent, and professional spoken English is essential. Candidates must be able to communicate clearly and confidently with caregivers, clients, families, and team members, particularly when handling urgent or time-sensitive situations.



The ideal candidate is calm under pressure, highly organized, responsive, and comfortable working independently.



Key Responsibilities



Manage after-hours staffing and scheduling needs.



Respond promptly to urgent staffing requests, call-outs, and schedule changes.



Coordinate replacement coverage when caregivers are unavailable.



Communicate with caregivers, clients, families, and internal team members by phone and other communication platforms.



Ensure information is communicated accurately and clearly.



Monitor staffing needs and help ensure continuity of client care.



Handle last-minute scheduling challenges and resolve issues efficiently.



Maintain accurate staffing and scheduling information.



Escalate urgent or critical concerns to the appropriate member of management.



Document after-hours calls, schedule changes, and important communications.



Follow company policies, procedures, and communication protocols.



Provide reliable coverage throughout assigned shifts.



Required Qualifications



Fluent, clear, and professional spoken English is required.



Must be able to speak and understand English clearly during phone conversations.



Strong verbal and written communication skills.



Must be comfortable communicating with individuals who may be stressed, upset, or experiencing an urgent staffing situation.



Previous experience in staffing, scheduling, home care, healthcare, customer service, dispatch, call centers, or a related field is preferred.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Ability to multitask and prioritize urgent requests.



Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.



Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.



Reliable attendance and punctuality are essential.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Comfortable using scheduling systems,
, phone, and other technology.



Must have a laptop/computer, reliable Wi-Fi/internet service, and a mobile phone with reliable cellular service.



Must be available to work the assigned after-hours schedule and holiday coverage requirements.



Must be available to start immediately if selected.



Important Communication Requirement



This is a phone-intensive position. Candidates must have:



Clear and easily understandable spoken English.



Strong listening and comprehension skills.



The ability to communicate professionally and confidently by phone.



The ability to understand different accents and communication styles.



The ability to explain scheduling information clearly and accurately.



The ability to communicate effectively during urgent or high-pressure situations.



Candidates may be asked to participate in a phone or video interview to assess English communication skills and overall suitability for the position.



Work Schedule



All shifts are in Pacific Time.



Schedule



Thursday: 5:00 PM – Friday 8:00 AM



Friday: 5:00 PM – Saturday 8:00 AM



Saturday: 8:00 AM – Sunday 8:00 AM



Employees are responsible for providing reliable coverage throughout their assigned shifts and must be available for the full duration of each scheduled shift.



Holiday Coverage



This position requires 24-hour holiday coverage from 8:00 AM on the holiday through 8:00 AM the following day.



Major holidays include, but are not limited to:



New Year's Day



Memorial Day



Fourth of July



Labor Day



Thanksgiving Day



Christmas Day



If a holiday falls on one of the employee's regularly scheduled days, the employee typically assigned to that day will be responsible for the holiday shift from 8:00 AM on the holiday until 8:00 AM the following day.



Additional holiday coverage may be required based on operational needs. Whenever possible, employees will receive at least two (2) weeks' advance notice of any additional holiday coverage requirements.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for a dependable, proactive, responsive, and confident After-Hours Staffing Coordinator who communicates exceptionally well in English.



The successful candidate must be comfortable handling staffing challenges independently, communicating by phone for extended periods, and responding quickly and professionally when unexpected situations arise.



We are looking to fill this position immediately and are ready to move forward with the right candidate as soon as possible.



If you are organized, reliable, solutions-oriented, and have excellent spoken English, we encourage you to apply.

title: Walmart Seller Product Hunting specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Walmart Product Sourcing Specialist to help identify profitable products for our Walmart Marketplace business.



The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Walmart product hunting, Online Arbitrage (OA), and Wholesale sourcing. You should understand how to research products, analyze profitability, and identify opportunities suitable for both Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) and Seller Fulfilled orders.



Responsibilities



• Research and identify profitable products to sell on Walmart Marketplace

• Source products through Online Arbitrage and Wholesale suppliers

• Conduct detailed product hunting and competitor research

• Analyze sales price, product cost, Walmart fees, shipping costs, ROI, and profit margins

• Identify products suitable for WFS and Seller Fulfilled

• Research product demand, competition, pricing history, and seller count

• Find reliable retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and suppliers

• Maintain organized sourcing and product research spreadsheets

• Monitor existing products for pricing and profitability changes

• Previous experience sourcing products for Walmart Marketplace

• Experience with Walmart WFS and Seller Fulfilled products

• Strong product hunting and research skills

• Ability to calculate ROI, profit margins, fees, and other costs accurately

• Familiarity with Walmart Seller Center and product research tools is preferred

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

• Good written and spoken English

• Strong attention to detail

• Hardworking, reliable, and self-motivated

• Able to work independently without constant supervision

• Must be consistent and willing to meet sourcing/product research goals



We are looking for someone who understands profitable sourcing, not simply finding products. The candidate should be able to evaluate opportunities carefully and provide products that meet our profitability and sourcing requirements.



Experience with Amazon sourcing, Keepa, SellerAmp, or similar product research tools is a plus.

title: Construction & Property Virtual Assistant
description:
Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours per Week

$200–$300 USD per month, depending on experience

Long-Term Role with Opportunity to Progress to Full-Time



About the Role



We are a growing UK-based group of businesses operating across construction consultancy, property management, serviced accommodation and property investment.



We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and dependable Virtual Assistant to support our Directors and wider business operations.



This is not intended to be a short-term freelance position. We are looking for someone who can learn our businesses, gradually take ownership of recurring workstreams and develop into a trusted long-term member of the team.



The role will initially be 20 hours per week, with the opportunity for responsibilities, hours and pay to increase as the role develops.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will vary as you become familiar with the businesses and may include:



• Inbox and
 management

• Calendar and meeting scheduling

• Task management and follow-ups

• Document and file management

• Invoicing and basic bookkeeping administration

• Property and tenancy administration

• Serviced accommodation administration

• Updating business systems and CRM platforms

• Scheduling appointments and property viewings

• General research

• Marketing and business development support

•
 marketing and outreach

• Social-media research, planning and scheduling

• Website updates and basic maintenance

• Preparing and updating trackers and reports

• General administrative support

• Helping document and improve internal processes



You will not be expected to know everything from day one.



Training will be provided, and responsibilities will be introduced gradually as you become familiar with our businesses and systems.



Who We Are Looking For



We are particularly interested in someone who is:



• Highly organised

• Reliable and consistent

• Proactive

• Eager to learn

• Comfortable taking responsibility

• Able to communicate professionally in written English

• Detail-oriented

• Comfortable working independently

• Good at prioritising multiple tasks

• Confident using technology and learning new software

• Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT appropriately

• Willing to ask questions when something is unclear

• Interested in developing with a growing company



You do not need previous construction or property experience.



Experience in administration, virtual assistance, property, real estate, social media, bookkeeping or marketing would be useful, but attitude, organisation and willingness to learn are more important.



The Person We Want



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of tasks every day.



Initially, you will receive plenty of guidance and training. However, as you develop in the role, we want you to become comfortable identifying what needs to be done, following up outstanding actions and taking ownership of recurring responsibilities.



For example, rather than being reminded every week that a report needs updating or that someone needs following up, we would eventually expect you to recognise that as part of your workstream and manage it.



We value initiative, communication and reliability.



Training & Development



Full training will be provided on our internal systems and processes.



The role will develop gradually. You may initially support relatively straightforward administrative tasks before taking responsibility for larger recurring workstreams.



Where additional resources are required as the businesses grow, we will recruit additional team members. The intention is to build an effective team, not continually increase one person’s workload.



Hours



20 hours per week initially.



There will need to be some overlap with UK working hours for communication, meetings, scheduling and certain property-related tasks.



Other administrative work can generally be completed flexibly.



Pay & Progression



Starting salary: $200–$300 USD per month, depending on experience.



Please state your expected monthly salary and/or hourly rate in your application.



The role will begin with an initial 3-month probationary period.



We will review performance and development after the first three months and again as the role develops over the following six months.



For the right person, there is an opportunity to progress towards:



• Greater responsibility

• Ownership of specific workstreams

• Increased pay

• Increased working hours

• A full-time position

• A long-term role within our growing businesses



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your CV/resume.

2. A short written introduction about yourself.

3. Details of any relevant Virtual Assistant, administrative, property, marketing or bookkeeping experience.

4. Your current employment situation and availability.

5. The hours you are normally available to work.

6. Your expected monthly salary and/or hourly rate.

7. Details of your computer and internet setup.

8. The software and online systems you are comfortable using.

9. Details of how you use AI tools such as ChatGPT in your work, if applicable.

10. A short video introduction telling us a little about yourself, your experience and why you are interested in the position.



Your video does not need to be professionally produced. We are primarily interested in your communication, personality and how you present yourself.



Applications should be clear and concise.



As a small attention-to-detail check, please begin your application with the exact phrase “PROPERTY & CONSTRUCTION” before writing anything else.



We review applications carefully, so please make sure you have read the full advert before applying.



Applications that do not follow all of the instructions above will not progress to the next stage of the recruitment process.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

 Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.

title: Virtual Assistant and Business Development
description:
What you will own



Discovery and qualification



Respond quickly to new inquiries by telephone,
, SMS and approved digital channels during business hours.



Conduct confident, conversational discovery calls that uncover the prospect's business, current situation, urgency, decision criteria, concerns and desired outcome.



Qualify opportunities against the firm's current service scope, client-fit standards, timing, decision authority and minimum engagement requirements.



Explain the firm's services and process in clear everyday language while recognizing when a technical question must be escalated to a CPA.



Create accurate discovery summaries so the CPA or delivery team can understand the opportunity without repeating the entire conversation.



Sales follow up and closing



Move qualified prospects from discovery to proposal, decision and signed engagement using the firm's approved sales process.



Follow up consistently and professionally by telephone,
 and SMS; no viable opportunity should be forgotten, left without a next action or allowed to stall silently.



Handle common objections involving price, timing, trust, scope and comparison with other firms through thoughtful questions and value-based responses.



Coordinate and issue approved proposals, engagement documents, scheduling links and information requests accurately and on time.



Close suitable engagements within approved pricing and discount authority, and escalate exceptions rather than improvising terms.



Re-engage inactive prospects and respectfully close lost opportunities while recording the actual reason for the decision.



Use ethical, consultative selling at all times. Never pressure vulnerable clients, misrepresent services or promise tax savings, refunds, deadlines or outcomes.



CRM and administrative ownership



Keep the CRM accurate and current, including contact information, source, service interest, qualification notes, pipeline stage, expected value, next action and follow-up date.



Maintain calendars, confirm appointments, reduce no-shows and ensure discovery calls begin with the required information available.



Draft polished client communications, call recaps, follow-up messages and internal handoff notes with excellent grammar and judgment.



Track outstanding documents, proposal status, unanswered questions and internal commitments until each item is resolved.



Support light executive and operational administration, including meeting preparation, task coordination, reporting and process documentation.



Protect confidential personal, financial and tax information and follow all approved privacy, consent and communication procedures.



Handoff and client experience



Once an engagement is signed, coordinate a clean handoff into onboarding so the client never feels dropped between sales and service delivery.



Confirm what was sold, what information is required, who owns each next step and when the client should expect the next communication.



Identify urgent deadlines, complaints, legal or privacy concerns and high-value opportunities, and escalate them immediately through the approved channel.



Look for recurring questions, friction and lost-sale patterns, then recommend practical improvements to scripts, templates, workflows and the client journey.

What success looks like



Measure



Successful performance



Speed



New leads receive prompt, professional attention during business hours and urgent matters are escalated without delay.



Conversion



Qualified prospects advance through discovery, proposal and closing at agreed targets without aggressive or misleading selling.



Follow through



Every open opportunity has a documented owner, next action and date; no lead disappears because of weak administration.



Accuracy



CRM records, proposal details, call notes and client commitments are complete, current and dependable.



Client experience



Prospects feel welcomed, understood and clear about the next step, whether they sign, defer or decline.



Handoff



Signed clients enter onboarding with the agreed scope, documents, deadlines and internal responsibilities clearly documented.



Required qualifications



At least three years of success in consultative sales, client success, account coordination, professional services or another client-facing closing role.



A demonstrated ability to conduct discovery, build trust quickly, follow up persistently, respond to objections and ask confidently for the business.



Exceptional spoken and written English, including a polished telephone and video-call presence with North American clients.



A genuinely upbeat, warm and energetic personality. You make people comfortable quickly while remaining professional, thoughtful and respectful.



Outstanding administrative discipline, attention to detail and ability to manage numerous leads, deadlines and conversations without losing control of the pipeline.



Practical experience using a CRM, calendar,
, video meetings and cloud-based document or proposal tools.



Sound judgment with confidential information and the maturity to stay within approved authority.



Reliable high-speed internet, a professional remote workspace and availability throughout Calgary business hours in Mountain Time.



Strong advantages



An accounting or business degree, bookkeeping qualification, accounting-firm experience, or hands-on work as an accountant or bookkeeper.



Working knowledge of bookkeeping, financial statements, corporate tax, GST or HST, payroll and the common problems faced by small-business owners.



Experience with QuickBooks Online, GoHighLevel or another CRM, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Calendly and electronic proposal or signature platforms.



Experience selling accounting, tax, bookkeeping, advisory or other trust-based professional services.



Experience improving scripts, follow-up sequences, CRM workflows, SOPs or sales reporting.



This role will suit you if



You enjoy speaking with people and can bring positive energy even after hearing several no's.



You are comfortable asking direct questions about a prospect's situation, priorities, budget and decision process.



You can be persistent without becoming pushy and persuasive without becoming misleading.



You want your performance measured through response time, follow-up completion, pipeline accuracy, qualified conversion and signed engagements.

title: Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser - Land Development & JV Modeling
description:
Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser — Land Development & JV Modeling

Fully Remote · Philippines-Based · Full-Time · US Central Time Shift · Reports Directly to the VP of Operations



Why This Role Exists

We are a Central Texas land development and investment firm doing what most of our competitors cannot: turning raw acreage tracts of varying sizes into fully platted, revenue-generating subdivisions. We move fast, we structure JVs directly with landowners, and we deploy real capital on real deals every month.



The problem: our deal flow is outrunning our modeling capacity. Feasibility studies, absorption schedules, and JV waterfalls are stacking up on the VP of Operations' desk — and every day one sits there is a day a deal moves slower. That is where you come in.



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

• You have taken 3+ live deals from raw acreage to landowner-ready JV pitch — independently.

• The VP of Operations and Founder review your models at the assumption layer, not the formula layer.

• Landowners see your work directly. Your name is on the pro forma at the meeting.



What You Will Actually Do

• Turn raw land into revenue models. Take a raw acreage tract — size depends on the project — decide the lot cut, allocate infrastructure cost, phase the release, and build the per-lot P&L.

• Model absorption like a real one. Monthly ramp schedules by phase — no flat annual averages, no divide-by-12.

• Run Sales Comparable Analyses on land and lots using aged, expired, and active comps to establish real value and defensible days-on-market.

• Build JV waterfalls that hold up under an attorney's audit — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits, land-contribution structures.

• Produce investor-facing return summaries (IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash) for our own JV investment deals — reviewed by ownership and counsel prior to distribution.

• Package landowner-ready decks and spreadsheets that need no revisions before they hit a Zoom call.

• Sit in on live deal calls with US ownership and iterate on assumptions in real time.



Required — Non-Negotiable

• 3–5 years institutional real estate underwriting at Colliers, JLL, Leechiu, Santos Knight Frank, Cushman & Wakefield, CBRE PH, Ayala Land, Megaworld, SMDC, or equivalent.

• Portfolio of at least 2 land or JV models you personally built (anonymized acceptable).

• Demonstrated absorption rate modeling — you must be able to show a live sample ramped monthly schedule during the interview.

• Working knowledge of JV waterfall structures — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits.

• Advanced Excel — dynamic formulas, sensitivity/data tables, scenario toggles, INDEX/MATCH, XIRR.

• Fluent business English — written and spoken, for direct communication with US ownership and occasional landowner presentations.

• Willing and able to work US Central Time business hours — 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time (approximately 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time). This is a hard requirement: our deals happen on Texas time, and you sit on the Texas team.

Preferred (Not Required)

• MLS-based comp research experience (Highly Preferred). Comfort pulling and interpreting US MLS data is a big edge.

• Financial modeling certification: REFM (Levels 2–3), REFAI, CFI FMVA, Wall Street Prep REFM, or BIWS Real Estate Modeling. REFM Level 3 With Distinction is a strong plus but not required — reps beat certs.

• Prior exposure to US real estate — CoStar, LandVision, Redfin, MRICS, or US brokerage/PE experience.

• Civil engineering, surveying, or platting familiarity.



Compensation

Starting pay: $400 – $500 USD per week based on experience and demonstrated skill. Paid weekly via wire or approved remote-payment platform.



How to Apply

Send all three items to 
 with subject line: "RE Analyst — [Your Name]", or message us and include the link to the requested files.

1. A sample land or JV waterfall model you personally built (anonymized OK).

2. Proof of any financial modeling certifications held (if applicable — not required to apply).

3. Availability windows for a 30-minute screening call within the next 10 business days.



Shortlisted candidates receive a 2-hour take-home underwriting test. Final round is a live screen-share with ownership. Serious applicants only — we read every submission personally.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About us

Flat Rate Bookkeeping does bookkeeping and payroll for roughly 1,000 small businesses on a simple flat monthly fee — no hourly billing, no surprises. We're a lean team that builds our own software (an internal platform on React and Supabase) and runs our own ads,
, and SMS in-house. Our default is to build a system rather than hire ten people to do something by hand.



The role

You'll own the top of our funnel. Today most leads come from Meta ads into GoHighLevel, where our sales reps work them. Your job is to build the machine that adds a second, third, and fourth channel — and to be accountable for the number of qualified conversations it produces each month.



This is a builder role, not an SDR role. You'll spend most of your time in enrichment tools, cold
 infrastructure, automation platforms, and scripts — not on the phone. But you own the outcome: qualified leads sitting in the reps' pipeline.



What you'll do



Build and run outbound end to end: list-building, enrichment, and multi-step
/SMS/LinkedIn sequences aimed at small businesses that need bookkeeping or payroll

Find and wire up buying signals — new business registrations (Sunbiz and other state filings), first-hire job postings, businesses outgrowing DIY software, S-corp election season, and whatever else you discover works

Own cold
 deliverability: domains, warmup, inbox rotation, bounce and spam monitoring

Pipe everything into GoHighLevel cleanly — tagging, rep routing, dedupe — so hand-off to sales is instant

Instrument the funnel from source → lead → booked call → client, so we know CAC by channel

Use LLM APIs and agents for research, personalization, and lead scoring wherever they beat a human doing it

Run experiments weekly (new segment, new signal, new angle) and kill what doesn't work fast

Work with the sales reps to define "qualified" and tighten it from their feedback



Our stack (you'll inherit this)

GoHighLevel (CRM + sequences), Meta Ads, Brevo 
), Twilio (SMS), Supabase, Vercel, and a custom internal platform on TanStack Start/React. You'll have room and budget to add tools — Clay, Apollo, Smartlead/Instantly, n8n/Make, or whatever you make the case for.



What success looks like



30 days: funnel audited, one new outbound channel live with real sends

90 days: [X] qualified conversations per month from channels you built, with CAC tracked per channel

6 months: outbound and signal-based lead gen is a predictable contributor alongside paid ads



Who you are



2+ years in a GTM engineering, growth engineering, RevOps, or technical outbound role where you built pipeline systems rather than just used them

Hands-on with enrichment and outbound tooling (Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Smartlead/Instantly, or equivalents) and automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier)

Comfortable in code: Python or JavaScript for scrapers, API glue, and data cleanup; SQL to pull your own numbers

Have run cold
 at volume and kept domains healthy doing it

Think in experiments and can point to a channel you built from zero, with numbers

Sharp written English — you'll write the first-touch copy that meetings depend on



Nice to have



Sold or marketed to small/local businesses before

GoHighLevel experience

Familiarity with accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll buyers

title: Leasing Sales Specialist
description:
About ParkNation

ParkNation invests in, manages, and operates manufactured housing and RV communities across Texas and California. We are building a centralized, function-based operations team — specialized remote roles working hand-in-hand with on-site field teams, Rent Manager workflows, and automation. Building Communities. Creating Opportunities. Improving Lives.

The Role

We're hiring two remote Leasing & Sales Specialists to provide dependable prospect coverage — answering calls and messages, qualifying leads, explaining programs, processing applications and bookings, and following up until close. You'll own the lead during your coverage window and document everything in ParkNation's systems.

What You'll Do

• Answer inbound leasing/sales calls and respond to text,
, and web inquiries during assigned coverage hours

• Qualify prospects — community, product, timing, budget, household, and space requirements

• Pull accurate inventory, pricing, availability, photos, and approved incentives

• Explain space leases, long/short-term RV stays, home rentals, rent-to-own, and home sales where applicable

• Schedule tours and appointments; process short-term RV bookings

• Assist prospects through applications, required documents, underwriting steps, and deposits

• Advance qualified prospects through the pipeline and coordinate handoffs to Operations or other team members

• Log every call, message, note, task, and pipeline update accurately in GoHighLevel and Rent Manager

Systems Experience — Required

Familiarity with GoHighLevel (CRM, phone, text, pipeline) and Rent Manager (Prospects/Leasing Board) is required. Candidates without hands-on experience in at least one of these systems will not be considered; experience with both is strongly preferred.

Requirements

• Previous remote customer service, inside sales, leasing, reservations, hospitality, real-estate, or call-center experience

• Excellent spoken and written English; bilingual English/Spanish required

• Comfortable asking direct qualification and closing questions

title: Inventory & Stock Systems Specialist
description:
Our Australian beauty salon is looking for an experienced Inventory & Stock Systems Specialist to build, implement and then manage our inventory system across multiple locations.



We have 1,000+ consumable items across nails, beauty, skin, bar, cleaning, retail and operations. We need someone who can take what is currently a very manual process and turn it into a highly organised, data-driven inventory system.



The biggest part of this role is connecting our service data with stock consumption.



For example, if a location completes 400 manicure services, 150 pedicure services and 80 lash lifts in a month, we want our system to understand approximately how much product those services should consume, compare that against actual stock usage, and help determine what needs to be ordered next.



We want to get to the point where purchasing is proactive and forecasted, rather than someone noticing we're running low and placing an order.



You will be responsible for:



- Auditing our existing inventory and purchasing processes

- Recommending and implementing the right inventory management software/system

- Building a master inventory database of 1,000+ consumables and products

- Mapping consumables to individual services and treatments

- Establishing expected product consumption per service

- Using service volume to forecast future stock requirements

- Creating minimum/maximum levels, par levels, safety stock and reorder points

- Factoring supplier lead times and MOQs into purchasing

- Analysing historical ordering and usage patterns

- Creating suggested purchase quantities based on actual and forecast service demand

- Managing purchase orders and supplier ordering remotely

- Tracking outstanding orders and expected deliveries

- Creating stocktake processes for our on-site teams

- Reconciling physical counts against expected inventory

- Identifying unusual usage, wastage, shrinkage or incorrect ordering

- Managing stock transfers between locations

- Tracking supplier pricing and changes in product cost

- Building dashboards showing stock levels, usage, purchasing and costs

- Creating SOPs so every location follows the same process

- Managing and continuously improving the system once implemented



The end goal



We want a system where we can see:



Services performed → expected product usage → actual stock remaining → upcoming demand → recommended order quantity → purchase order → delivery → updated inventory.



If we know we're likely to perform 500 of a particular service next month, the system should help us understand what products are required to deliver those 500 services, what we already have on hand, what is already on order and exactly what we need to purchase.



This is a fully remote role. Our on-site teams will physically count stock and receive deliveries; you will own the system, data, purchasing and inventory management behind them.



Who we're looking for



You must have genuine experience in inventory management, inventory planning, procurement or inventory systems implementation.



Experience with multi-location businesses and large numbers of SKUs is highly regarded.



We're particularly interested in people who have worked with inventory forecasting, BOMs/recipes, consumption-based inventory, automated replenishment or demand planning.



When applying, please tell us what inventory systems you've used or implemented and give us an example of how you've previously used sales/service data to forecast purchasing or stock requirements.

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
**Brands:** Grace Flowers & Maison Tamar

**Work Arrangement:** Remote

**Role Type:** [Full-Time / Part-Time — to be confirmed]



## About the Brands



We are looking for a creative, highly organized and execution-focused **Social Media & Content Manager** to manage the organic social presence of two growing consumer brands:



**Grace Flowers** — a luxury modest womenswear brand focused on sophisticated, distinctive fashion and storytelling.



**Maison Tamar** — a premium beauty house with products across hair and beauty, built around quality, authenticity, education and an elevated customer experience.



Although both brands sit within the fashion and beauty space, they have **distinct identities, audiences and content strategies**. We are looking for someone who understands how to build and maintain those distinctions.



The Role



This is not a role for someone who simply schedules posts.



You will be responsible for developing the **content strategy and content pillars for each brand and translating them into consistent, engaging content across social platforms.**



You should be able to take brand objectives, product information, existing photo/video assets and raw footage and independently turn them into compelling social content.



We are looking for someone who can **think strategically and execute hands-on**.



## Key Responsibilities



### Social Media Strategy & Content Planning



* Develop and maintain clearly defined **content pillars for each brand**.

* Build monthly and weekly content calendars aligned with launches, campaigns, product priorities and business objectives.

* Develop platform-specific strategies for Instagram, TikTok,
, Pinterest and other relevant platforms.

* Research trends, competitors, customer interests and emerging content opportunities.

* Identify appropriate trending sounds, formats, hooks and conversations without compromising the brands' positioning.

* Develop recurring content series that build familiarity, authority and audience engagement.

* Recommend content opportunities rather than waiting to be told what to post.



### Content Creation



* Create engaging **Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, graphics and short-form videos**.

* Edit raw footage into polished, platform-ready content.

* Write scripts, hooks, captions, headlines and strong calls to action.

* Repurpose long-form and existing brand assets into multiple pieces of social content.

* Create polished graphics using Canva or equivalent tools.

* Edit short-form video using CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, Filmora or similar tools.

* Maintain strong visual consistency with each brand's guidelines.

* Support product launches, campaigns, educational content, behind-the-scenes storytelling and promotional content.



### Platform Management



Manage day-to-day content across relevant channels, including:



* Instagram

* TikTok

*

* Pinterest

* YouTube Shorts, where applicable



This includes publishing, scheduling, optimizing captions and hashtags/keywords, maintaining profiles and ensuring content is formatted appropriately for each platform.



### Community Management



* Monitor and respond appropriately to comments and direct messages.

* Encourage meaningful engagement and conversation.

* Identify common customer questions that can become future content.

* Escalate customer-service or sensitive issues when necessary.

* Help cultivate an engaged community around both brands.



### Social Search & Discoverability



* Conduct social keyword and hashtag research.

* Optimize captions, titles, descriptions and platform content for discoverability.

* Understand the increasing importance of search behavior on platforms such as TikTok, Instagram and Pinterest.

* Work with the Digital Growth & Performance Marketing Specialist to ensure organic content supports broader SEO and marketing objectives.



### Analytics & Optimization



Track and report on:



* Reach and impressions

* Engagement rate

* Follower growth

* Video views and watch time

* Saves and shares

* Profile visits

* Link clicks

* Top-performing content

* Organic website traffic where available



You should be able to explain **why content performed or underperformed** and use those insights to improve future content.



## What We're Looking For



You should have:



* Demonstrated experience managing social media for brands, businesses or e-commerce companies.

* Strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok.

* Excellent short-form video editing skills.

* Strong Canva/design skills and visual judgment.

* Excellent written English and copywriting ability.

* Experience developing content strategies, **not simply following an existing calendar**.

* Ability to develop content pillars from a brand's positioning and target audience.

* Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, CTAs and audience retention.

* Strong understanding of platform trends and algorithms.

* Ability to manage two distinct brand identities without making their content feel interchangeable.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines.



Experience in **beauty, hair, fashion, luxury or premium consumer brands** is highly desirable.



## Important



We are looking for someone who can **hit the ground running**.



You should not require daily instructions telling you what content to create. Once you understand the brand strategy, products, audience and upcoming priorities, you should be able to proactively develop ideas, build the calendar, create content, publish it, analyze performance and continuously improve.



## Application Requirements



Please submit:



1. Your résumé/CV.

2. Your portfolio.

3. Links to social media accounts you have personally managed.

4. Examples of Reels/TikToks you personally edited.

5. Examples of graphics/carousels you personally created.

6. A brief explanation of your specific role on each account shown in your portfolio.

7. Screenshots or examples of measurable results you achieved — growth, engagement, reach, traffic, views or sales where available.

8. The social media and content tools you are proficient in.





Please clearly distinguish between content you personally created and content created by a wider team.



Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a PAID practical assessment using Grace Flowers and Maison Tamar brand materials.

description:
We are hiring a Business Funding Qualifier / Sales Closer to speak with incoming funding leads, review their eligibility, explain our process, and complete client onboarding.



You will be the first point of contact for prospective clients. Your focus is accurate qualification, clear communication, signed agreements, confirmed payments, and complete records for the Funding Specialist.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Confirm that clients have their credit-monitoring information ready before the review and reschedule when essential information is missing.

- Review authorized credit information with clients and confirm business details, revenue, time in business, and funding needs.

- Assess eligibility against the company's qualification criteria and escalate borderline or incomplete files.

- Explain the service, fees, agreement terms, and next steps clearly without guaranteeing funding outcomes or timelines.

- Answer questions professionally and help qualified prospects complete their agreements and payments through approved systems.

- Complete client intake records and verify that signed agreements and cleared payments are documented before advancing the file.

- Keep GoHighLevel pipeline stages current so automated client updates and specialist handoffs run correctly.

- Report daily calls, qualifications, completed onboarding, collected fees, and follow-up activity in Slack.

- Protect confidential client information and escalate concerns promptly.



REQUIREMENTS

- Clear spoken and written English and strong phone or Zoom communication skills.

- Experience in sales closing, client qualification, financial services, or a related client-facing role.

- Ability to review credit information carefully and follow qualification criteria without guessing.

- Strong working knowledge of GoHighLevel, including contacts, pipelines, and follow-up workflows.

- Familiarity with Slack, Zoom, credit-monitoring tools, electronic agreements, and invoice or payment-link systems.

- Organized follow-through, accurate recordkeeping, and professional objection handling.

- Good judgment and respect for client confidentiality.



This role focuses on qualification and onboarding. Funding application planning and live application guidance are handled by the Funding Specialist.



COMMISSION

In addition to base pay, you will earn a 0.5% commission on the funding secured for each client you help get funded.



Example: If you help a client secure $10,000 in funding, you earn an extra $50 in commission for that client, in addition to your base pay.

1. Your resume and a brief summary of your sales, qualification, or funding experience.

Contact → Engage → Schedule → Confirm → Complete



Simply scheduling an appointment does not qualify for commission. You are expected to maintain communication with your scheduled patients, confirm their appointments, and actively work to help reduce cancellations and no-shows.



Our practice generates a high volume of incoming leads, providing significant earning potential for an agent who is consistent, organized, persistent, and effective at converting leads into completed consultations.

title: Business Research Analyst
description:
About the role

We are seeking a researcher to help the CEO make informed decisions across Cadothy’s AI companion robots and all-in-one live streaming studios, as well as our preschool business. You will investigate competitors, identify unmet customer needs, track relevant policies, and evaluate locations and businesses for potential expansion or acquisition, with an initial focus on Texas and selected other US states.

You will turn business questions into structured research, verify evidence, analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and explain what the findings mean for our next steps. Preschool research is a major part of this role. Priorities and deadlines will be agreed with the CEO.



Key responsibilities

Competitor and customer research

• Build and maintain competitor comparisons covering products or services, pricing, target customers, positioning, strengths, weaknesses, and customer experience. For preschools, compare tuition, programs, age groups, hours, locations, and enrollment or waitlist information where available.

• Analyze reviews, community discussions, and available customer feedback to identify recurring praise, complaints, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve our offerings. Group findings into consistent themes and explain the limitations of the sample.

Policy and regulatory research

• Monitor relevant state, local, and federal policies, including preschool licensing, staffing requirements, funding programs, and business incentives, as well as policies affecting our technology products. Use original government sources, record jurisdiction and effective dates, and distinguish proposals from rules in force.

• Summarize potential operational or growth implications, eligibility conditions, and questions requiring specialist verification.

Expansion and acquisition research

• Compare potential preschool markets and locations using factors such as families with young children, household income, population trends, competition, tuition, property costs, and available workforce or licensing information.

• Find businesses offered for sale and maintain a shortlist with location, asking price, reported financials, capacity or enrollment where available, property or lease details, and fit with our criteria. Label seller claims and missing information clearly; identify questions for further due diligence.

Research execution and recommendations

• Define the research question, scope, methods, sources, and comparison criteria before collecting information. Combine online research with databases, publications, public records, and approved interviews or inquiries when needed.

• Clean and organize data, perform basic statistical analysis, and prepare concise reports with findings, supporting evidence, business implications, options, and recommended next steps. Maintain an organized, searchable research archive and protect confidential information.

 

Required qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a research-oriented discipline such as statistics, economics, business, public policy, education, psychology, or social sciences, or equivalent demonstrated research training and experience.

• Demonstrated experience completing structured research projects, preferably at least two years in business research, market research, policy analysis, or a comparable role. Substantial graduate research experience may also qualify when supported by relevant work samples.

• Ability to translate an open-ended business question into a practical research plan, assess source credibility, cross-check conflicting information, and separate verified facts, estimates, assumptions, and recommendations.

• Working knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methods, including thematic coding, sampling limitations, data cleaning, and basic descriptive statistics such as counts, percentages, means, medians, ranges, and trends.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, and comparable data tables. Ability to document sample sizes, denominators, missing data, and the basis for comparisons.

• Ability to use AI tools to assist with research planning, discovery, extraction, and synthesis, while checking material claims against original sources and reviewing calculations independently.

• Strong written English and clear business writing. Able to summarize complex findings concisely, explain uncertainty, work independently, and manage competing deadlines.



Preferred qualifications

• Master’s degree, PhD, or substantial postgraduate research training in a relevant discipline. Candidates with university research, thesis, dissertation, or research assistant experience are encouraged to apply.

• Formal coursework or practical experience in statistics, applied research methods, survey design, or quantitative analysis. Familiarity with Python, R, SPSS, SQL, or a comparable analysis tool is a plus.

• Experience researching US preschool or childcare markets, consumer technology, state policies, site selection, or small-business acquisitions. Familiarity with Texas markets is helpful.



Expected deliverables

• Competitor and customer insight trackers with comparable fields, source links, dates checked, review themes, and clearly identified information gaps.

• Policy briefs and location or acquisition shortlists explaining relevance, screening criteria, evidence, key assumptions, and follow-up questions.

• A concise executive brief for each major assignment, supported by organized data and reproducible calculations where applicable. Include the research question, method, main findings, limitations, business implications, and recommended next steps.



*Message me at



Success will be assessed through source accuracy, sound methods, clear analysis, timely delivery, and usefulness for decisions. Project scope and reporting frequency will reflect agreed working hours and research complexity.

Verify reservations from Airbnb, 
, Expedia, direct website bookings, and other channels are coming through correctly.

, Google, Yelp, and other platforms.

Assist with initiatives designed to increase direct bookings.

Escalate serious guest, payment, reservation, or operational problems immediately.

Daily Priority



We do not want someone who spends the entire day completing random administrative tasks while important reservation problems are being missed.



Your priorities should generally be:



Reservations → Availability → Revenue/Occupancy → Channel Problems → Group Leads → Guest Issues → Breezeway Operations → Reviews/SEO → Administrative Tasks



You should be comfortable opening the systems at the beginning of your shift and determining what needs attention without waiting for management to tell you every single thing to do.

New bookings | Cancellations | Revenue booked | Occupancy/availability concerns | Group leads & follow-ups | Guest issues | Breezeway issues | Channel/listing problems | Reviews completed | SEO/marketing work | Items requiring management attention



Experience We're Looking For

Previous hands-on Breezeway experience

Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail

Strong spreadsheet/Google Sheets skills

Ability to work independently

Ability to troubleshoot problems rather than simply report them

Reliable internet and ability to work consistently during assigned hours



Experience with any of the following is highly preferred:



Mews PMS, PriceLabs, Airbnb, 
, Expedia, SiteMinder, Canary Technologies, Google Business Profile, Yelp, or similar hospitality systems.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS — READ CAREFULLY



We receive many applications, so generic applications will not be considered.



Start your application with:



BREEZEWAY OPS



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, we will assume you did not read the job description.



Then answer ALL of the following questions:



1. Breezeway Experience

2. Breezeway Scenario

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer – Q4
description:
**Pay Per Approved Lead | Potential Long-Term Opportunity**



Wagner Supply Co. is a growing Amazon business looking for an experienced Online Arbitrage (OA) Product Sourcer to help us increase our sourcing capacity for Q4.



This is initially a short-term, pay-per-approved-lead position expected to last approximately 1–2 months. However, this is not necessarily just a temporary opportunity. If you consistently find high-quality, profitable leads and are a great fit with our team, there is an opportunity to transition into a long-term/full-time position.



We already have an established sourcing process, tools, and lead requirements. We are looking for someone who has real Amazon OA sourcing experience and can begin producing quality leads quickly.



Compensation - $10 per approved lead.



You are paid for leads that meet our sourcing requirements and are approved—not simply for the number of products submitted.



Initially, there will be a maximum of 5 paid approved leads per day. This may be increased based on performance and business needs.



There are no required daily working hours during the initial pay-per-lead contract. You may determine your own sourcing schedule, but consistent performance and communication are expected.



What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be finding profitable Online Arbitrage opportunities for our Amazon FBA business.



You should already be comfortable with:



- SellerAmp SAS

- Keepa and Keepa chart analysis

- Storefront stalking

- Manual sourcing and other OA sourcing strategies

- Buy Box analysis and price history

- Sales velocity and sales-to-offer ratios

- FBA fees, ROI, profit and margin

- Seller competition

- Amazon's presence on a listing

- IP and brand-risk analysis

- Exact product/variation matching

- Evaluating retailers and sourcing websites



We are primarily looking for 25%+ ROI opportunities with healthy sales, stable pricing and manageable competition.



In limited circumstances, products with 20–24.9% ROI may be considered when the sales-to-offer ratio is exceptionally strong and the overall opportunity is compelling.



Complete sourcing criteria will be provided to the selected candidate.



Qualifications

You should have previous hands-on experience sourcing Online Arbitrage products for an Amazon seller.



This is not intended to be an entry-level sourcing position. Completing an Amazon course alone does not qualify as sourcing experience.



We're looking for someone who can demonstrate that they understand how to evaluate an opportunity—not simply find products that appear profitable based on current pricing.



Strong attention to detail is extremely important. You must be able to confirm that source products exactly match the Amazon listing, including quantity, size, variation, model and other relevant product details.



Tools

The selected candidate will be provided access to the tools necessary to perform the role, including SellerAmp and Keepa.



Your sourcing activity and leads will be tracked through our established sourcing process.



Leads found for Wagner Supply Co. are confidential and may not be submitted, sold or shared with other Amazon sellers.



How to Apply

To show that you have read the entire job posting, put #27 in the subject line of your application.



Please answer all of the following questions:



1. How long have you been sourcing Online Arbitrage products for Amazon sellers?

2. Tell me about your most recent Amazon sourcing position. How long did you work for that seller, and why did the position end?

3. What sourcing strategies have you personally used? Please be specific.

4. Which Amazon sourcing tools have you used?

5. Approximately how many products would you typically research during a normal sourcing day?

6. Approximately how many viable leads would you typically submit in a day?

7. How do you use Keepa when d
 whether a product is a good lead?

8. How do you evaluate sales velocity compared with the number of competing offers?

9. What are some reasons you would reject a product even if SellerAmp currently showed good ROI and profit?

10. Are you currently sourcing products for any other Amazon sellers? If yes, please explain your current work arrangement.

11. What categories are you most experienced sourcing?

12. Please list the sourcing methods you have personally used (for example: storefront stalking, manual sourcing, Keepa Product Finder, reverse sourcing, etc.).



Please do not send a generic application. We are specifically looking for experienced Amazon OA sourcers, and applications that do not follow the instructions above will not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Remote Production Assistant
description:
