title: WordPress Developer & Technical SEO Specialist
description:
Full-time remote | Philippines | U.S. Central Time

Pay: $12-$15 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience. Paid weekly.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break. 40 working hours per week.

Occasional weekend emergency coverage is compensated separately under agreed terms.

Schedule follows Dallas/Chicago time, including U.S. daylight saving changes.





About Buddy Moving



Buddy Moving is a Texas moving company serving the Dallas-Fort Worth area. We are looking for a dependable, hands-on WordPress specialist to keep our website working well, implement updates promptly, and improve our visibility in search.

This is an implementation role, not an SEO reporting-only position. You should be comfortable making the changes yourself, checking your work, and explaining what was completed. We value steady ownership and clear communication over big promises.



What you will do



Build and update WordPress pages, layouts, FAQs, team bios, service pages, images, navigation, and approved website content. Make changes responsive and easy to use on desktop and mobile.



Troubleshoot website problems, plugin conflicts, broken links, forms, tracking scripts, and relevant integrations. Verify that quote requests reach the correct destination, not just that the page displays a success message.



Improve technical and on-page SEO: page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, crawlability, indexing, canonical tags, redirects, sitemaps, and appropriate structured data.



Improve loading speed and user experience without breaking important functionality. Identify useful local SEO and service-page improvements for a moving business.



Maintain WordPress, themes, and plugins using a controlled process. Use an appropriate test environment, backups, quality checks, and a rollback plan for changes that could affect the live site.



Track requests, communicate realistic turnaround times, document changes, and flag risks or blockers early. Coordinate with management and any marketing partners on priorities.



Expected focus: approximately 60% website implementation and troubleshooting, 25% SEO improvements, and 15% monitoring, quality checks, and documentation.



What we are looking for



At least three years of hands-on WordPress experience, or an equivalent portfolio showing strong independent work. You must be able to explain exactly what you personally built or fixed.



Strong HTML and CSS, practical JavaScript, and enough PHP/WordPress knowledge to diagnose errors and make maintainable custom changes. Experience with common editors or builders and the ability to work within an existing site setup.



Practical technical and on-page SEO experience, preferably for U.S. local-service businesses. Comfortable using Google Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed Insights, and an SEO plugin or comparable tools.



Sound judgment with hosting, backups, staging, security, permissions, and production changes. You do not experiment blindly on a live business website.



Clear written and spoken English, dependable attendance, and a reliable computer, internet connection, and realistic backup plan for power or connectivity interruptions.



Ability to work the full agreed schedule without conflicting work commitments. This is a direct individual role; do not subcontract or share access without written approval.



Helpful, but not required: experience with lead-generation forms, CRM connections, Google Tag Manager, Git/version control, local SEO, and moving or home-service websites.



Schedule and emergency coverage



The regular shift is 10:00 p.m.-7:00 a.m. Philippine time while the U.S. observes Central Daylight Time, and 11:00 p.m.-8:00 a.m. during Central Standard Time. Shifts start Monday-Friday nights in the Philippines; Friday's shift finishes Saturday morning. The one-hour lunch break is within this window.



Occasional weekend on-call coverage is for genuine emergencies, such as an unavailable website or a broken quote-request process. Coverage windows, response expectations, and additional compensation will be agreed in advance. This is not an expectation of continuous 24/7 availability.



Success in the first 30-60 days



You understand the website setup, deliver routine changes within agreed deadlines, catch issues before publishing, verify important lead paths, maintain a clear change log, and make measurable progress on a prioritized SEO and website-improvement backlog.



To apply



Use the subject line: BUDDY WEB - Your Name.



Confirm the full U.S. Central schedule, both Philippine shift times, and your ability to discuss occasional weekend coverage.



Provide your resume, expected hourly rate in USD, earliest start date, and any commitments that overlap our working hours.



Share two or three WordPress examples. For each, explain your personal contribution, editor/builder used, and one problem you solved.



Describe one technical SEO improvement you personally implemented and the evidence of its impact. Redacted client examples are welcome.



Describe your primary internet connection and practical backup plan. A short introduction video is optional.

Hiring process: application review, a paid practical exercise for finalists ($35 for up to 90 minutes), and a short live walkthrough. No production website access is required for the assessment.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
# Social Media Manager – E-Commerce Brands



We are looking for a creative, reliable, and experienced **Social Media Manager** to help manage and grow our e-commerce brands across multiple social media platforms.



Our brands sell fashion, sports, Greek/sorority, accessories, fans, bags, umbrellas, and other lifestyle products. We are looking for someone who understands how to create content that **gets attention, builds engagement, and helps convert followers into customers**.



This is not a position for someone who only knows how to post graphics. We need someone who can take initiative, develop content ideas, stay on top of trends, and help us grow.



## Responsibilities



* Manage Instagram,
, TikTok, and Pinterest

* Create and maintain a weekly/monthly social media content calendar

* Create engaging Reels, TikToks, Stories, posts, and promotional content

* Edit short-form videos using CapCut, Canva, or similar tools

* Write captions, hooks, calls-to-action, and hashtags

* Schedule and publish content consistently

* Repurpose existing product photos and videos into new content

* Research current trends, sounds, content ideas, and competitors

* Create content around new products, sales, pre-orders, launches, and promotions

* Help generate content ideas that encourage customers to purchase

* Respond to comments and help maintain engagement

* Monitor social media messages and flag customer-service issues when necessary

* Track content performance and identify what is working

* Provide a simple weekly report showing growth, engagement, top-performing content, and recommendations

* Help manage TikTok Shop/social commerce content

* Assist with influencer/UGC content ideas when needed



## What We're Looking For



You should have:



* Previous experience managing social media for an e-commerce or product-based business

* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels and TikTok

* Experience with Canva and AI

* Experience editing short-form videos

* Excellent written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow brand guidelines

* Ability to work independently without needing instructions for every post

* Understanding of social media trends and online shopping behavior

* Ability to meet deadlines and communicate consistently



Experience with **Shopify, TikTok Shop, Meta Business Suite, Pinterest, CapCut, Canva, or social media scheduling platforms** is a plus.



## VERY IMPORTANT



We are looking for someone who is **creative and proactive**.



I do not want to provide every caption, every content idea, and every trend for you to use. I need someone who can look at our products and say:



**“Here are 5 ways we can market this product this week.”**



You should be comfortable researching ideas and bringing suggestions to the table.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your social media experience.

2. Links to **2–3 social media accounts** you have personally managed.

3. Examples of Reels, TikToks, graphics, or other content you created.

4. Tell me which platform you believe is best for selling physical products right now and why.

5. Give me **3 content ideas you would use to promote a clear stadium bag, hand fan, or umbrella.**

6. Tell me which programs/apps you use for content creation and scheduling.

7. Put the word **CROWN** at the beginning of your application so I know you read the entire job description.



Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application.



## Compensation



Compensation is negotiable based on experience, skill level, portfolio, and availability.



There is an opportunity for ongoing long-term work for the right person.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Position Summary



ShieldPoint IT LLC is seeking a motivated commission-based Lead Generator and Appointment Setter to help expand our client base among small and growing businesses. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with outbound sales, prospecting, and initiating conversations with business owners and decision-makers.



The primary responsibility will be to identify qualified prospects, communicate the value of ShieldPoint IT’s managed IT and cybersecurity services, uncover business pain points, and schedule qualified appointments for the sales process.



About ShieldPoint IT



ShieldPoint IT provides fully managed IT and cybersecurity services designed to help small and growing businesses operate securely, reliably, and efficiently. Rather than waiting for technology failures or responding after a cyberattack occurs, we proactively monitor, secure, maintain, and support our clients’ entire IT environments.



Our goal is simple: keep businesses running securely with predictable monthly costs and fast, dependable support when they need it.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate should:



Have experience in lead generation, cold calling, appointment setting, or B2B sales.

Be confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers.

Know how to identify and sell to customer pain points rather than simply listing services.

Be able to communicate the business value of managed IT and cybersecurity solutions.

Be comfortable following an established sales script while adapting naturally to each prospect.

Be persistent, professional, organized, and results-oriented.

Understand that the goal of the initial conversation is to create interest, qualify the prospect, and secure a meeting, not necessarily close the entire sale.

Key Selling Points



The Lead Generator should be able to position ShieldPoint IT around common business concerns such as:



Unexpected IT problems and downtime

Cybersecurity threats and data breaches

Lack of reliable internal IT support

Slow response times when technical issues occur

Rising and unpredictable technology costs

Lack of proactive monitoring and maintenance

The need to protect business operations while allowing employees to work efficiently



ShieldPoint IT has a sales script prepared for the successful candidate. The right person should be able to use the script effectively while having the communication skills to uncover a prospect’s specific challenges and explain how ShieldPoint IT can help.



Primary Objective



The primary objective of this role is to generate qualified leads and schedule appointments with businesses that could benefit from managed IT and cybersecurity services, creating a consistent pipeline of opportunities for ShieldPoint IT LLC.

title: Email & SMS Marketing Specialist (Mindbody/Frederick, Attentive, Zapier)
description:
Email & SMS Marketing Specialist (Mindbody/Frederick, Attentive, Zapier)

$7.00/hour · Full time · Long term



Read this whole post before applying. The last question tells you how to apply, and I delete every application that skips it.







WHO WE ARE



LevelNext Consulting is a San Diego marketing agency. We run marketing for a small group of clients in regulated industries: a law firm, a medical spa, a mortgage broker, an insurance agency, a real estate training company.



"Regulated" is the whole job. Our clients cannot say whatever they want in an
. A medical practice cannot promise a result. A law firm has advertising rules. If you send the wrong message to the wrong list, it is not an embarrassing mistake, it is a legal one.



We are small, we move fast, and we write things down.







WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



You own the
 and SMS channel end to end for our client accounts. Not writing the copy, we have writers. You build it, you check it, you send it, and you report what happened.



Building and sending



Build and schedule
 campaigns in Mindbody's Marketing Suite (Frederick), Attentive, and Zoho CRM

Build automations and sequences: welcome flows, post-appointment follow ups, re-engagement, post-event follow ups

Build and maintain the segments and contact lists those sends go to

Load and QA
 templates in HTML when the drag and drop editor is not enough



Automation and plumbing



Build and maintain Zapier workflows connecting our tools

Set up and troubleshoot Apollo and HeyReach outreach sequences

Diagnose why an automation did not fire, and fix it



Reporting and QA



Pull open, click, and conversion numbers weekly into Notion

Send yourself a test of every campaign before it goes out, every time

Check the contact count on every list before anything is attached to it

Flag what is not working before anyone has to ask







THE PART MOST APPLICANTS GET WRONG



Last month we found a set of segments on a client account that had been returning zero contacts. They looked completely normal in the interface. The filter was pointed at the wrong field, so every list came back empty, and nothing in the software said so.



That is the job. The software will not tell you when you are wrong. A campaign sent to zero people looks exactly like a campaign that worked. A list that a
 matches your client's entire database looks exactly like a list that matches the right 40 people.



The person we hire reads the count. Every time. Before, not after.



If your instinct when a list returns a surprising number is "that seems off, let me check," we want to talk to you. If your instinct is "the system built it, so it must be right," this is not your role.







TOOLS WE USE



You will not know all of these. Nobody does. Tell us honestly which ones you have actually used and for how long.



/SMS: Mindbody Marketing Suite (Frederick), Attentive, Zoho CRM Campaigns

Automation: Zapier, 
, HeyReach

Analytics: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager

Websites: WordPress with Elementor, Squarespace

Ops: Notion, Slack, Google Workspace

Design: Canva



If you have deep Klaviyo, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign or HubSpot experience and have never touched our stack, still apply. The thinking transfers. The buttons do not, and we can teach buttons.







COMPLIANCE, BECAUSE IT IS NOT OPTIONAL



You will be responsible for:



An unsubscribe link in every marketing
, no exceptions, CAN-SPAM

Cross-referencing the do-not-send list before every single send

Never adding anyone to a list without checking they have not opted out

SMS consent rules, TCPA

Never editing approved copy for a medical or legal client without approval



We will train you on the specifics. We need you to take them seriously without being reminded.







WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



General virtual assistants who also do some
. This is a specialist role.

Anyone who needs a task list every morning. You will own the channel.

Anyone uncomfortable saying "I checked and it is broken, here is what I found." We would much rather hear bad news early.







WHAT WE OFFER



$1,200/month, paid twice monthly, on time, always

Full time and long term. We are hiring a person, not filling a gap

Paid Philippine holidays and paid time off after 90 days

13th month pay

Real ownership of a channel, and your work goes directly to clients

We write everything down, so you are never guessing what happened last week







HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with the subject line:
 SPECIALIST - [YOUR FAVORITE
 TOOL]



In the body, answer these five. Short answers are fine. Honest answers are better than impressive ones.



You build a segment and it returns 0 contacts. Walk me through exactly what you check, and in what order.



Before you send a campaign to 2,000 people, what do you check? List every step.



Tell me about a send that went wrong. Wrong list, wrong people, broken link, anything. What happened, how did you find out, and what did you change afterward? "It has never happened to me" is a weaker answer than a real story.



Which of these have you personally used, and roughly how long? Mindbody or Frederick, Attentive, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Zoho, Zapier, Apollo. Be honest. We will find out in the interview and we do not mind gaps.



What is one thing you would want to check in our systems in your first week?



Applications that do not answer all five are deleted without reading.

title: Graphic Designer + Shopify Website Designer -Experienced
description:
We’re Badass Outdoor Gear, an outdoor and hunting gear company based in Utah in the USA. We sell archery equipment, hunting gear, outdoor apparel, e-bikes, optics, and more through our retail store and Shopify website.



We’re looking for an EXPERIENCED Graphic Designer / E-Commerce Website Designer who can take an idea and turn it into professional, attention-grabbing graphics that help sell products.



This is NOT an entry-level position.  



What I Need



I will give you the basic direction of what I want. From there, you need to take ownership of the project.



For example, I may tell you:



“We need a homepage banner promoting Sitka hunting gear.”



It will be your responsibility to come up with the design concept, find or create the appropriate graphics, determine the layout, create the promotional message, and deliver a finished design.



I am very direct, move quickly, and do not have time to provide step-by-step instructions.  If you expect me to repeat myself with directions because you cannot read well or take good notes properly then this job is not for you.   



Ask me the questions you need upfront, then get the project done.



I want someone experienced enough that I do not have to constantly correct their work.



Responsibilities



• Design Shopify homepage banners and website graphics

• Create product advertisements and promotional graphics

• Create graphics that catch attention and sell products

• Find, edit, or create graphics/images needed for each project

• Develop creative concepts instead of waiting for detailed instructions

• Help redesign and improve our Shopify homepage

• Create graphics for sales, product launches and seasonal promotions

• Maintain consistent Badass Outdoor Gear branding

• Proofread everything before submitting it

• Suggest design and promotional ideas that could improve our website and sales



If you are good, there is a lot of ongoing work available. I would eventually like this person to help redesign our homepage and replace/improve most of the graphics throughout our website.



REQUIRED Skills



• Strong professional graphic design experience

• Excellent English communication

• Excellent spelling and grammar

• Experience designing for e-commerce

• Ability to work independently with minimal instruction

• Strong creative ability — you need to bring your own ideas

• Fast and responsive communication

• Excellent attention to detail

• Ability to meet deadlines without being reminded

• Professional portfolio showing REAL work you personally created



Highly Preferred



• Shopify experience

• Hunting/outdoor industry experience

• Experience designing for outdoor, hunting, archery, sporting goods, or apparel brands

• Understanding of the U.S. outdoor/hunting customer

• Experience designing website graphics specifically to increase clicks and sales

• Photoshop / Adobe Creative Suite or similar professional design software



Position



• Ongoing work

• Approximately 15–30 hours per week to start. Pay will depend on your qualifications and experience.

• Opportunity for more hours if you are excellent

• Flexible schedule

• Must be available to communicate with the owner regularly



TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a good fit.

2. Your graphic design portfolio.

3. 3 examples of website banners or e-commerce advertisements you personally designed.

4. Any outdoor, hunting, sporting goods, or similar brands you have worked with.

5. Your Shopify experience.

6. Your hourly or monthly rate.

7. After reviewing 
, tell me 3 specific things you would change about our homepage design or graphics and WHY.



IMPORTANT: Only applicants who apply using a minimum of 7 Apply Points and provide a portfolio that matches the quality/style we are looking for will be considered.



If you need detailed instructions for every project, this position will not be a good fit.  



I am looking for someone who can communicate, think, create, and execute without constant supervision.  I do expect things to get done timely and correct, without reminding you.  



No phone calls please.  I would like you to answer the questions above first and I will respond.  Thank you.

title: AI Training & Data Labelling Assistant
description:
About the Role

This is a unique opportunity to contribute directly to the development of real-world artificial intelligence.



Working within our internal platform, you'll review AI-generated security camera events and determine whether each event represents genuine tailgating or legitimate member access. Your decisions will become part of the training data used to continuously improve the accuracy of our computer vision models.



This is not a customer service or administration role. It is a focused analytical position that requires exceptional attention to detail, consistency, and sound judgement. No previous AI or machine learning experience is required, full training will be provided.



* Review AI-generated security events throughout the day

* Analyse sequences of security camera images from member entry events

* Determine whether each event represents tailgating or legitimate member access

* Assign confidence levels to each decision

* Record notes where additional context is helpful

* Flag unusual or uncertain events for internal review

* Apply labelling guidelines consistently across every event

* Help create accurate datasets used to train and improve AI models

* Maintain confidentiality when accessing security footage and operational systems



Training & Support

 You'll receive comprehensive onboarding before commencing, including:

* Training on our internal AI platform

* A detailed labelling guide

* Examples of common and complex scenarios

* Ongoing feedback to ensure consistency and accuracy

* Support from the internal team for difficult or uncertain cases





Requirements

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

* Patient, methodical, and highly consistent in decision-making

* Ability to follow detailed guidelines and apply them consistently

* Comfortable performing repetitive analytical tasks while maintaining high accuracy

* Strong organisational and time management skills

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

* Professional, trustworthy, and able to handle confidential information responsibly

* Quick learner who is comfortable using new software and internal platforms

* Strong observational and critical thinking skills

* Reliable internet connection

* Personal laptop or desktop suitable for the role

* Quiet workspace suitable for focused work



Experience in any of the following is advantageous:

* Data entry

* Administration

* Quality assurance

* Security monitoring

* Operations

* Analytical or research-based roles



Benefits



* Full training provided

* Opportunity to contribute to real-world artificial intelligence systems

* Work with cutting-edge computer vision technology

* Flexible remote working arrangement

* Supportive team and structured onboarding

* Valuable experience in AI data annotation and machine learning

* Potential opportunities for future contract extensions or additional AI projects based on performance

title: Marketing Manager — Online Yoga & Meditation School
description:
About Us

We are an online school for tantra yoga and meditation. We offer a 200-hour Yoga and Meditation Teacher Training (YTT), a growing library subscription, standalone courses, and one-on-one mentorship.



We are preparing for a major November 2026 launch of our newly redesigned and expanded YTT program, and we need a skilled marketing manager to join our small, tight team and own the day-to-day execution.



The Team You'll Be Joining

You won't be working alone. Our founder leads all creative — copy, messaging, design direction, and brand voice. Our operations lead manages
 ads and performance. Your job is to sit in the middle: taking what we've built and executing it consistently, responsively, and independently.



This means you don't need to be a creative director or a data analyst. You need to be a skilled executor who understands social media marketing, keeps everything moving, and never lets a lead go cold.



The Role



A note on how we work: we're not looking for someone who just waits for instructions and executes them passively. We want a real thinking partner in this seat — someone who will push back when they see a better way to do something, bring their own ideas to the table, and treat this as their domain to improve, not just a task list to complete. You'll be given direction, but we want you to question it when it's worth questioning and come to us with strategy, not just status updates.



A performance bonus is available at the end of the launch for someone who executes well and helps us hit our goals.



Core responsibilities:



- Social media scheduling — taking our branded content and scheduling it consistently across
 and Instagram; maintaining a content calendar and keeping us on track



- Community and DM management — responding to comments and DMs promptly and professionally; leads and sales inquiries that come in through social need to be responded to immediately, not at the end of the day



- Lead tracking — maintaining an active, organized list of leads coming in through social; nothing falls through the cracks



- ManyChat (or equivalent) setup and management — setting up automated comment and DM flows so that people who engage with our content can instantly get information about our programs



- Launch calendar coordination — keeping assets, links, deadlines, and the broader launch calendar organized and on schedule



What We're Looking For



- Social media execution experience — you know how to schedule, post, and maintain a consistent presence across
 and Instagram



- Fast, professional community management — you understand that a comment or DM left unanswered for hours is a lost lead; responsiveness is non-negotiable



- Independent strategic thinking — you notice what isn't working and speak up with better ideas rather than waiting to be told



- ManyChat or similar automation tools — you've set up comment and DM flows before, or you're confident you can learn quickly



- Highly organized and self-directed — you manage your own time, keep lists, and don't need to be chased



- Excellent written English — your DMs and comments represent our brand



- Spiritual, wellness, or yoga industry experience is a strong plus — our audience is serious practitioners; understanding the space matters



How This Works



Step 1 — Paid trial period (approx. 1 week): A small group of candidates will each receive the same paid trial project. This gives us a real sense of how you work, how you communicate, and what you're capable of. The candidate who completes the project to the highest standard moves forward.



Step 2 — Full-time contract (October–January): The successful candidate joins us on a full-time contract for the duration of the teacher training launch. This is real, substantial work, not freelance hours on the side.



Step 3 — Permanent position (opportunity): There is an opportunity to move into a permanent full-time role after the launch for the right person.



How to Apply

Please send us your resume, along with links to any creatives you've previously made — samples of both video and image are preferred. Also tell us your favourite food in your application.



We are a small, values-driven school. We want someone who takes pride in their work, responds like a professional, and genuinely cares about the mission.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant — Recruiting Operations

US Eastern hours  ·  Remote (Philippines)  ·  Full-time, long-term

We’re a US-based recruiting and RPO firm hiring at volume for skilled-trades and manufacturing clients, and we need an Executive Assistant who runs our operation like it’s their own — someone who anticipates what the team needs before we ask and keeps everything moving without being told. You’ll be the operational right hand to our account manager and recruiters. We have plenty of process; what we need is the judgment to run it and the ownership to get ahead of problems before they land on someone’s desk.

The person we’re looking for

You think in outcomes, not tickets. When a recruiter forgets to update the tracker, you catch it before the recap is due and chase it down. When a role has sat untouched, you flag it. When the same error keeps recurring, you don’t just fix it — you tell us how to stop it. You hold the moving pieces so the team doesn’t have to, and you stay calm when five things hit at once because you know which one matters first.

What you’ll own

● A clean, current pipeline — resumes uploaded and filed in our ATS (Workable), duplicates caught, statuses accurate as roles open and close

● Data the team can trust — hiring spreadsheets, tracker, and ATS kept in sync, with discrepancies surfaced before they become problems

● New roles ready before they’re needed — postings, interview guides, and Indeed projects built from our templates ahead of demand

● Interviews without friction — you own the scheduling logistics and stay ahead of reschedules and no-shows

● Reporting on time, every time — you assemble our weekly client recaps and operations report, chasing what’s missing so the account manager can review and send

● A team a step ahead — you anticipate what’s coming, prep the recurring meetings, and raise what needs attention before it turns urgent

Long-term seat with real ownership on one dedicated account team — not a rotating gig. You’ll start with a defined scope and take on more as you earn trust.

One clarification: you won’t screen candidates, make hiring decisions, or handle client calls — those stay with our recruiters and account manager. Everything that keeps the operation a step ahead of the team is yours to own.

What you’ll need

● Experience as an executive assistant or right-hand to a busy leader or team — real responsibility, genuine autonomy

● A track record of anticipating needs and owning outcomes, not just completing assigned tasks

● Hands-on database experience and confident Google Sheets / Excel skills

● Sharp attention to detail and excellent written English

● The judgment to know when to run the playbook, when to improve it, and when to raise a flag

Nice to have: Executive supporting experience

Schedule & setup

Full-time, US Eastern business hours — an evening-to-overnight shift in the Philippines, with guaranteed overlap through the US morning. Requires reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection and backup power (UPS or generator).

How to apply

Start your message with the word PRECISION so we know you actually read this. Then send your resume and tell us about one time you saw something your team or manager needed before they asked for it — and how you handled it.

title: Medical SEO Content Writer

It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. - Pharmacy

-Allied health

- Medical sciences

- Public health

- Healthcare

- Other related healthcare or medical disciplines

- Professional content-writing experience.

- Previous experience writing medical or healthcare content.

- Strong medical research skills.

- Good understanding of medical terminology.

- Excellent written English.

- Strong grammar, editing, and proofreading skills.

- Good attention to detail.

- Ability to write original, plagiarism-free content.

- Ability to follow detailed briefs and instructions.

- Search intent

- Heading structure

- Internal linking

- Meta titles and descriptions

- On-page SEO

- Content structure

- Google E-E-A-T principles

- The importance of accuracy and trustworthiness in healthcare content



Preferred Experience

- Healthcare or medical websites

- SEO agencies

- Digital marketing agencies

- Doctors, clinics, hospitals, or medical organisations

- WordPress

- Google Docs

- Similar SEO or content optimisation tools



Who We Are Looking For

You must have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, and be available during agreed working hours.

Shortlisted applicants will complete a short practical assessment designed to test both medical knowledge and SEO writing ability.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant – U.S. Accounting Firm



Visionary Accounting Solutions is a U.S.-based accounting firm seeking an experienced Senior Bookkeeper / Accountant to join our remote team.



This position is ideal for an experienced accounting professional who can work independently, understands the why behind accounting entries, and is comfortable investigating and correcting complex bookkeeping issues.



Our work goes beyond basic transaction entry. We work with established U.S. businesses, including multi-entity clients, and frequently handle historical cleanups, reconciliations, month-end accounting, and financial reporting. We are looking for someone who can identify problems, research discrepancies, and use sound accounting judgment to determine the appropriate solution.



Key Responsibilities

Manage bookkeeping and accounting for U.S.-based clients

Categorize and review bank and credit card transactions

Perform bank, credit card, loan, and balance sheet reconciliations

Prepare and post journal entries

Assist with month-end and year-end close

Review balance sheet accounts for accuracy and identify unusual balances

Investigate and correct historical bookkeeping and accounting issues

Work with multi-entity businesses and intercompany transactions

Review supporting documentation and research discrepancies

Assist with accounting cleanup and catch-up projects

Review work for accuracy and maintain clear supporting documentation

Communicate questions, findings, and progress clearly and professionally

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field

7+ years of progressive bookkeeping/accounting experience

Strong understanding of accounting principles, debits and credits, and balance sheet integrity

Advanced QuickBooks Online experience

Strong bank and balance sheet reconciliation skills

Experience working with U.S. small and mid-sized businesses

Experience with multi-entity accounting preferred

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to work independently and recognize when something does not look correct

Strong written English communication skills

Dependable, organized, and comfortable working as part of a remote team

Accounting Skills Assessment



Candidates who move forward in the hiring process will be required to complete an accounting skills assessment.



The assessment is designed to verify practical accounting knowledge, including reconciliations, journal entries, account classification, financial statement understanding, and the ability to identify and resolve accounting errors.



Computer Requirements — REQUIRED



Because this position involves access to U.S. client accounting systems and confidential financial information, applicants must have a reliable business-class Windows computer that meets or exceeds the following specifications:



Intel Core i5 processor or better

16 GB RAM

512 GB SSD

Windows 11 Pro

Built-in or external webcam and microphone

Reliable high-speed internet connection



Windows 11 Pro is required. Windows 10 and Windows 11 Home do not meet the requirements for this position.



Applicants should verify their computer specifications and Windows edition before applying.



What We Value



We value accuracy, accountability, communication, and good judgment.



We do not expect someone to know the answer to every accounting question. We do expect our team members to recognize when something is incorrect, investigate the issue, ask thoughtful questions when necessary, and avoid making assumptions simply to complete a task.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



A brief introduction describing your accounting experience.

Your years of experience using QuickBooks Online.

A description of your experience with accounting cleanup and reconciliation projects.

Your current computer processor, RAM, and Windows edition.

Confirmation that you are willing to complete an accounting skills assessment as part of the interview process.



Please begin your application with the words “Balance Sheet” so we know you carefully reviewed the entire job posting.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter, US Trades, Part-Time, 5 to 8am Manila, $10/hour USD, Experienced Only
description:
COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER

Part-time, remote, Monday to Friday, 2:00 to 5:00 PM US Pacific (5:00 to 8:00 AM Manila)



Looking to grow our team. One part-time cold caller, 15 hours a week, who will undergo a two-week paid trial before being brought on for the long run.



We are more than a cold-calling gig. SoftOut builds custom software and automations for local service businesses in the Sacramento, California area: plumbers, HVAC, electricians, cleaners and contractors. The first caller who books consistently is the one who trains the second caller and runs the calling team. If you seek a long-term, advancing seat, this is for you.



PSA



Every dial is recorded and every booked call is checked. If you log dials you did not make, book calls the owner never agreed to, use an autodialer, or call for another company during our window, you will be let go immediately. Our list, our script, our phone number and our sheet stay with us when you leave. No exceptions.



We are seeking an experienced caller who can hit a number without being watched. There is no training. If you have never cold called US businesses for pay and cannot tell us your numbers, do not complete this application.



Job Responsibilities



- 75 dials a day, Monday to Friday, 2:00 to 5:00 PM Pacific. That is 5:00 to 8:00 AM Manila now, and 6:00 to 9:00 AM from November 1 when US clocks change. Fixed hours.

- Run our script. There is no sale. It is an offer of a 15-minute call with the owner of SoftOut.

- Book the time and send the invite before the next dial.

- Log every dial and booked call in our sheet with the outcome and one line on what the owner said.



Requirements



- Cold calling or appointment-setting experience to US businesses, with numbers you can state: dials, conversations, bookings, and over what period

- Clear, natural English on the phone. A plumber in California has to keep listening.

- Free 5:00 to 8:00 AM Manila every weekday, no other client in that window

- Quiet room, laptop or computer, headset, wired or fiber internet

- A Google account for the sheet and Slack for the team



Compensation



- $10 an hour USD, paid every Friday. Payment by Wise only.

- Independent contractor. W-8BEN signed before the first payment

- US holidays off

- Leads, script, US phone line, calendar and website link supplied. Nothing to buy.



What we are looking for



This should be simple. We want someone who does not need supervision, is on the line at 4:55 every morning, and treats the person on the other end like a person. Owners of plumbing companies can hear a script being read from a mile away. You have to sound like a neighbor, not a call center. We track dials, conversations and bookings every week. The trial bar is at least one booked appointment every work week. Below that after two weeks, we part ways with no hard feelings. Loyalty matters most to us. We are looking for someone who stays for years and can see themselves running the calling team. If you've made it this far, make the title of your application your favorite color.



We will not accept candidates who work for another client during our calling window. Slack is required for team communication.



To expedite your application, send your best week from a past cold-calling role in numbers: dials, conversations, bookings, and the offer you were selling. Our criteria: real numbers, not "a lot", and a booking rate you can explain.



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Have you been employed as a cold caller or appointment setter before?

2. If so, why did you leave?

3. What was the offer, and what were your dials, conversations and bookings per week?

4. Where are you located, and are you free 5:00 to 8:00 AM Manila every weekday?

5. Do you have another client right now, and what hours do you work for them?

6. What headset and computer do you use, and is your internet wired or fiber?

7. Describe the room you would call from.

8. Have you sold to US trades or local business owners before?

9. Why should we choose you?



Thanks for taking the time out of your day to apply. Best of luck.



Ilia Gaidai

SoftOut LLC

This is not just a people-management position. We are looking for someone who enjoys analyzing what is happening across the business, finding opportunities, developing ideas, and helping a talented marketing team execute them.



## Work Schedule & Compensation



* Full-time remote position

* Monday through Friday

* Typical schedule: approximately **2:00 PM–12:00 AM Philippine Time**

## What You'll Do



You will lead a small specialized marketing team while also serving as the company's primary growth and marketing intelligence resource.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Lead and coordinate our Paid Advertising, Content/Social, and SEO/PR team members

* Review marketing performance across channels and identify trends, problems, and growth opportunities

* Turn data and customer insights into clear priorities and actionable marketing ideas

* Develop and prioritize marketing experiments across advertising, landing pages, content, SEO, offers, and messaging

* Analyze customer behavior, reviews, search activity, competitors, and market trends to uncover new opportunities

* Help improve landing-page conversion rates, messaging, offers, and customer journeys

* Review weekly KPIs and make sure the team is focused on the highest-impact work

* Run short team meetings, remove blockers, and keep projects moving forward

* Review important marketing work for quality, accuracy, and brand consistency

* Help team members improve through coaching, feedback, and clear expectations

* Build and improve SOPs, processes, reporting, and marketing systems

* Use AI tools extensively for research, analysis, reporting, brainstorming, QA, and productivity

* Continuously look for better ways to grow the company and improve how the marketing team operates



## What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly analytical and naturally curious about why marketing performs the way it does

* Strong at turning data into practical marketing decisions

* Experienced with digital marketing, growth marketing, or performance marketing

* Knowledgeable about conversion optimization and customer journeys

* Comfortable working across paid advertising, SEO, content, social media, and analytics

* A strong communicator who can give clear direction without micromanaging

* Organized and capable of managing multiple priorities and team members

* Proactive and comfortable making recommendations rather than waiting to be told what to do

* Comfortable using AI as an everyday marketing and productivity tool

* Interested in testing ideas, learning from results, and continuously improving



## Helpful Experience

* Google Analytics / GA4

* Google Search Console

* Microsoft Clarity or other heatmap tools

* Google Ads and Meta Ads

* Looker Studio

* Google Sheets

* Conversion rate optimization

* A/B testing

* Customer and competitor research

* ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, NotebookLM, or similar AI tools



## The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here



We want someone who thinks like an owner.



You should be the type of person who sees a number change and wants to understand why, notices an opportunity and brings it to the team, and can take information from several different marketing channels and connect the dots.



Your job is not to personally do every marketing task. Your job is to help the specialists on the team do their best work, make sure we are working on the right things, and continuously find new ways for the company to grow.

-marketing, and advertising experience.

 campaign or promotion you created.

title: Experienced Amazon FBA Product Sourcer – Home Depot, Ryobi & Wholesale
description:
I run a growing Amazon reselling business specializing in tools and home-improvement products. We currently source heavily from one supplier and are expanding our Home Depot sourcing—particularly for Ryobi and RIDGID products.



I am looking for an **experienced full-time Amazon product sourcer** who can help us identify profitable, scalable, and replenishable opportunities.



This is **not an entry-level position**. You must already understand Amazon OA or wholesale sourcing, Keepa, SellerAmp, profit calculations, sales velocity, and competition analysis.



## Main Responsibilities



* Source profitable products from Home Depot and Direct Tools

* Focus primarily on Ryobi and RIDGID products

* Analyze Keepa charts, pricing history, Buy Box behavior, and seller counts

* Estimate monthly sales and our realistic share of those sales

* Calculate Amazon fees, shipping, profit, margin, and ROI accurately

* Research competitor storefronts and reverse-source promising ASINs

* Monitor Home Depot and Direct Tools promotions, coupons, bundles, free-tool offers, clearance deals, and restocks

* Find replenishable opportunities—not just temporary clearance products

* Investigate kits, bundles, multipacks, and product variations

* Maintain a detailed and organized sourcing spreadsheet

* Recheck promising leads and communicate findings clearly



## What I Am Looking For



We am **not** looking for filler leads, tiny opportunities, or surface-level sourcing.



We want:



* Scalable products

* Strong profit per unit

* Meaningful monthly sales volume

* Stable pricing

* Manageable competition

* Repeatable or replenishable opportunities

* Detailed research and honest risk analysis



Some days you may find only a few leads. That is completely fine if those leads are strong. One great replenishable lead can generate thousands of dollars in revenue and profit over time.



**Quality matters more than lead quantity.**



## Required Skills



* Previous Amazon OA or wholesale product-sourcing experience

* Strong Keepa knowledge, including knowledge of how to use Keepa Product Finder

* Strong SellerAmp knowledge

* Accurate profit, margin, and ROI calculations

* Ability to interpret sales rank and estimate sales velocity

* Strong competition and listing analysis

* Experience with supplier and reverse sourcing

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Reliable, self-motivated, and consistent

* Strong communication skills



Experience sourcing from **Home Depot,Ryobi, RIDGID, power tools, or outdoor power equipment** is highly preferred.



## Major Additional Advantages



The following will make an applicant stand out significantly:



* Experience finding manufacturers, distributors, and wholesale suppliers

* Experience using SmartScout

* Experience contacting brands and distributors through
, phone, contact forms, or LinkedIn

* Experience opening wholesale accounts and following up with suppliers

* Experience negotiating pricing, minimum orders, payment terms, or product lists

* Experience obtaining legitimate invoices for Amazon approval applications

* Successful experience with Amazon brand or category ungating

* Experience ungating tool brands such as **DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, or Bosch**

* Strong technical skills, including advanced Google Sheets or Excel, formulas, data extraction, automation, APIs, or basic scripting

* Experience using ChatGPT or Claude effectively for research, data organization, outreach, and workflow improvement



The immediate priority is sourcing profitable Ryobi and RIDGID products from Home Depot and Direct Tools. However, someone who can also develop wholesale relationships, assist with supplier outreach, and help us expand into additional tool brands will have greater responsibility and growth potential.



## Schedule and Compensation



* Full-time

* Approximately 8 hours per day

* 6 days per week

* Flexible working hours

* Reliable daily communication required

* $4 per hour base pay

* Performance bonuses for profitable sourcing results

* Long-term growth and earning potential for high performers



Results, consistency, and communication matter most.



## Training



You must already have sourcing experience, but we will work closely together during the first few weeks to align on our buying criteria, sourcing strategy, and preferred opportunities.



There will likely be regular Zoom calls initially while we refine the process.



## How to Apply



At the very top of your application, write:



**RYOBI PROFIT HUNTER**



Then answer every question below:



1. How long have you worked in Amazon OA or wholesale sourcing?

2. Which suppliers and websites have you sourced from?

3. Have you sourced from Home Depot or Direct Tools before?

4. Have you sourced Ryobi, RIDGID, power tools, or outdoor power equipment?

5. Explain how you evaluate a Keepa chart before recommending a purchase.

6. Provide two or three examples of strong leads you previously found. Remove confidential information, but include the purchase price, expected sale price, profit, ROI, estimated monthly sales, and why each lead was strong.

7. How do you estimate how many units we could realistically sell when several sellers are already on a listing?

8. What would make you reject a product even if SellerAmp showed a good ROI?

9. Describe any experience finding and contacting wholesale suppliers or opening wholesale accounts.

10. Have you successfully helped an Amazon seller become ungated? If yes, explain the brands or categories, supplier used, documents submitted, whether the application was approved, and your role. Experience with DeWalt or Makita is a major plus.

11. Describe your technical skills, including spreadsheets, automation, data extraction, APIs, scripting, ChatGPT, or Claude.

12. Include a short voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself and explaining one sourcing opportunity you previously found.

13. Why would you be a strong fit for this position?



Applications that do not include **RYOBI PROFIT HUNTER** and complete answers will not be considered.



I am looking for someone who genuinely enjoys sourcing, digging deeply into products, and finding opportunities that can meaningfully grow a business. This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

As a Sales VA, your main responsibility is to help turn new enquiries into booked calls, viewings, or qualified opportunities. You will be the first point of contact for many leads, so your communication needs to be clear, polite, confident, and persistent without being pushy.



You will work closely with the sales/property team to make sure every lead is followed up properly, logged correctly, and moved through the pipeline.

mber.

- Strong spoken and written English with a direct tone.

.

title: Executive Assistant / Operations & Bookkeeping VA
description:
I am looking for a highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented Executive Assistant / Operations VA to become my right-hand person and help bring structure and consistency to my business.



I am a small business owner and healthcare professional with a busy schedule. I am looking for someone whose strength is organization—someone who naturally keeps track of details, deadlines, finances, appointments, and unfinished tasks and who is comfortable following up with me when something needs my attention.



I do not want someone who needs to be told every small step. I am looking for someone who can eventually learn how my business operates, anticipate what needs to happen next, and help keep everything running smoothly.



Responsibilities



You may help with:



Managing my business calendar and appointments

Scheduling, rescheduling, and confirming client appointments

Keeping my calendar organized and preventing scheduling conflicts

Sending administrative follow-ups and reminders

Monitoring important deadlines and making sure tasks do not get forgotten

Maintaining an organized weekly and monthly task list

Basic bookkeeping and expense organization

Categorizing and tracking business expenses

Helping maintain QuickBooks or similar bookkeeping systems

Organizing receipts, invoices, payments, and financial documents

Keeping financial information organized for my CPA/tax professional

Tracking outstanding balances and administrative follow-ups

Creating spreadsheets and simple financial reports

Organizing documents and digital files

Creating checklists, systems, and standard operating procedures

Helping me create better workflows for repetitive business tasks

Identifying things that are falling through the cracks and bringing them to my attention



You would not be expected to prepare or file my taxes. Your role would be to keep everything organized so that my accountant or tax professional has what they need.



The Person I Am Looking For



You are probably a good fit if you:



Are extremely organized and detail-oriented

Enjoy creating structure and systems

Are proactive rather than waiting for instructions

Are comfortable reminding me about things more than once

Can prioritize what is urgent versus what can wait

Are comfortable working independently

Communicate clearly and professionally

Are reliable and consistent

Are comfortable handling confidential information

Have excellent written English

Are comfortable with technology and learning new software

Have experience supporting a business owner, executive, therapist, healthcare practice, or professional-service business



Experience with QuickBooks, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, calendar management, and practice-management software such as SimplePractice is a strong plus.



Because this is a healthcare-related business, confidentiality is extremely important. Experience working in healthcare or with HIPAA-sensitive information is preferred.



What I Need Most



I need someone who can look at a messy situation and think:



“I can organize this.”



I want someone who will eventually be able to tell me:



“Here are the three things that need your attention this week. I already handled these items, this one is waiting for a response, and I need this document from you by Thursday.”



That level of ownership and organization is what I am looking for.



Hours



Approximately 10-12 hours per week to start, with the possibility of additional hours as the role grows.



Some availability during U.S. business hours will be important for appointment scheduling and communication.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



“I create structure.”



Then answer the following:



Tell me about your experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations VA, or Bookkeeper.

Have you managed another person's calendar and appointments before?

What bookkeeping software have you used?

Have you worked with QuickBooks or Keeper?

Have you worked with healthcare, therapy, medical, or other confidential client information?

Tell me about a situation where you took something disorganized and created a system for it.

If your employer repeatedly forgets deadlines or tasks, how would you manage that?

What hours are you normally available?

How many hours per week are you currently available?

What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



Final candidates will be asked to complete a short paid skills assessment before a hiring decision is made.

title: CAD DRAFTER
description:
Location: Cupertino, CA (San Francisco Bay Area) – Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time



About AlphaX RE Capital

AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliated entities form a women-founded, integrated real estate firm based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Committed to creating innovative and sustainable housing solutions throughout California, our group manages an extensive and growing portfolio of assets and development projects. We are a leader in addressing the housing crisis by developing sustainable and affordable communities.

Taking a comprehensive approach, we oversee the complete real estate lifecycle from end to end. AlphaX emphasizes diversity, equity, and social impact, with initiatives such as the AlphaX Foundation and Small Builders Association empowering future leaders, women, and minorities in real estate. Our headquarters is located in Cupertino, CA, with additional offices in Southern California and Arizona.



Join our fast-growing architectural firm located in the vibrant city of Cupertino CA, backed by AlphaX RE Capital. Specializing in single-family homes, ADUs, SB9 projects, multi-family dwellings, and light industrial developments, we are a diverse team dedicated to excellence in every project. With an array of services covering the entire real estate spectrum, from land acquisition to property listing, our firm offers a unique environment for growth and learning.



Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented CAD Drafter to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating precise technical drawings and plans using computer-aided design (CAD) software. This role requires strong attention to detail, technical knowledge, and the ability to collaborate with engineers, architects, and project managers to bring designs to life.





Key Responsibilities

Develop and revise detailed technical drawings, blueprints, and schematics using CAD software.

Interpret design specifications, sketches, and notes to produce accurate plans.

Ensure drawings comply with industry standards, codes, and company guidelines.

Collaborate with engineers, architects, and other stakeholders to resolve design issues.

Maintain organized records of drawings, revisions, and project documentation.

Assist in preparing layouts, 3D models, and presentation materials when required.

Review and verify the accuracy of completed drawings before submission.





Qualifications

Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Drafting, Engineering Technology, Architecture, or related field.

Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, SolidWorks, or similar).

Strong knowledge of drafting standards, construction methods, and technical terminology.

Ability to read and interpret engineering and architectural drawings.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

Experience in [industry-specific focus, e.g., mechanical, civil, electrical, or architectural drafting] preferred.





Preferred Skills

Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM).

Experience with 3D visualization tools.

Knowledge of project management software.

Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously.





Fully Remote

Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:30 PM PST, Monday–Friday (12:00 AM–8:30 AM PH Time)

title: Customer Service and Dispatch Virtual Assistant (Inbound)
description:
We need someone who has an Amazing Communication skill with neutral accent





 A company in the home services industry is looking for a reliable, communicative, and highly organized Customer Service and Dispatch Virtual Assistant to join their growing team. This is a fully remote position supporting a fast-paced handyman services business that handles a high volume of customer calls, job scheduling, dispatching, and invoicing on a daily basis.



This role starts at 20 hours per week with the expectation to grow quickly into a full-time 40-hour-per-week position as call and job volume increases. The right candidate may even be considered for full-time hours from the start. You must be available and responsive throughout all scheduled working hours, including during slower periods when active calls or messages may be limited.



This is much more than an answering-the-phones role. You will be helping manage the entire flow of work from the moment a customer reaches out, all the way through job creation, handyman assignment, ongoing communication, and final invoicing.



Schedule: Central Time (CT), 20 hours per week to start, growing quickly to 40 hours per week





Responsibilities



- Answer a high volume of incoming customer calls in a professional, friendly, and clear manner.

- Understand each customer's needs and gather all necessary information about the requested handyman service.

- Follow up with customers through messaging after initial calls when needed.

- Respond to approximately 15 to 20 incoming customer messages and 6 to 13 calls per day, depending on volume.

- Create new jobs in Jobber (job management software) based on incoming calls and customer requests.

- Assign jobs to the appropriate handyman based on availability and job details.

- Review and manage the day's scheduled jobs to keep everything on track.

- Relay messages and job updates back and forth between customers and handymen to keep jobs moving smoothly.

- Coordinate job logistics in situations where the customer is not physically present at the property.

- Follow up with both customers and handymen to ensure all parties have the information they need.

- Learn and manage the invoicing process within Jobber.

- Send invoices to customers once jobs are completed.

- Keep all job information, customer communications, assignments, and invoices accurate and up to date.





Qualifications



- Native-level English speaker with a clear, natural-sounding American accent strongly preferred.

- Excellent phone presence and comfort handling a high volume of inbound calls.

- Strong customer service and written and verbal communication skills.

- Highly organized with the ability to juggle calls, messages, scheduling, dispatching, and administrative tasks simultaneously.

- Comfortable communicating with both customers and field technicians in a calm and professional manner.

- Strong follow-through and attention to detail.

- Able to work independently and stay productive during slower periods without supervision.

- Quick learner who is comfortable picking up new software and processes.

- Solution-oriented mindset when coordinating between customers and field staff.

- Reliable and consistently responsive throughout all scheduled working hours.

- Experience with Jobber is a plus but is not required. Full training will be provided.

- Prior experience in customer service, dispatch, scheduling, or a related field is highly preferred.





Why Join



The company is actively expanding into multiple locations, which means there is significant room for growth in this role. What starts as a part-time position has strong potential to become a long-term full-time opportunity as the business scales. You will receive full training on Jobber and all company-specific processes from day one.





How to Apply



To be considered for this role, please submit the following:



- Updated Resume

- Introduction Audio (Vacaroo is fine)



Applications without both items will not be reviewed. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Appointment Setter – Warm Leads + Cold Calling
description:
PLEASE READ



We are a US marketing agency that generates leads for home-service companies — pest control, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, waste, and more.



We are hiring an appointment setter to call warm leads, follow up with existing opportunities, make cold calls, and book qualified appointments directly onto the owner’s calendar.



How to apply



Two parts. Follow the format exactly. We are hiring someone who follows instructions precisely, so this application is the first test. Anything that skips a step will not be read.



 Part 1 — Your message



Start with the exact words “BOOKED” followed by the highest number of qualified appointments you have personally booked in one month — the number, the industry, the country, and whether they came from warm leads, cold calls, or

both.



Then state your available working hours in US Mountain Time and your desired hourly rate in USD.



 Part 2 — A Loom video, 90 seconds maximum



Cover these four things in this order:



1. Your name and your appointment-setting or phone-sales experience. Which industries, which countries, how long, and what you achieved. Give me real numbers.



2. Walk me through your numbers. Show me a CRM, spreadsheet, report, dashboard, or anything else you have. I want to see call volume, appointments booked, and show rate. Explain which of those results were personally yours. You do not need live account access. Any document you can speak to is fine.



3. Answer this out loud: a new warm lead comes through, but they do not answer your first call. Walk me through exactly what you do next. Include your call, voi
, text,
, and follow-up cadence.



4. Role-play the first 20 seconds of a cold call to the owner of a home-service company. Then tell me why you are the best fit for this role and why you deserve an interview with me.



Follow these instructions exactly or you will not get interviewed.



We read and watch every application that follows the format.



The job



You own every lead until a qualified appointment is booked on the owner’s calendar.



Your number-one priority is calling new warm leads immediately when they come through. If a new lead arrives during your shift, you stop what you are doing and call them as quickly as possible.



When all new leads have been contacted, you will:



  - Follow up with warm leads who have not booked

  - Call older leads and past opportunities

  - Reschedule no-shows

  - Send follow-up texts,
s, and voi
s

  - Make cold calls from lists we provide

  - Qualify prospects and book appointments

  - Confirm upcoming appointments

  - Keep every lead’s notes, status, and next action updated



You will use our CRM, calendar, dialer, scripts, follow-up processes, and AI tools. AI can help you write messages, summarize conversations, and manage follow-up, but you are still responsible for checking the work and making sure no lead gets forgotten.



I do not want to take over a lead until they are qualified and booked on my calendar. Once the appointment is booked and the CRM is updated correctly, I take over from there.



Every appointment must be legitimate. We do not want unqualified people booked just to increase your numbers.



Your priorities



Work through leads in this order:



  1. New warm leads

  2. Scheduled warm-lead follow-ups

  3. Older leads who have not booked

  4. No-shows and reschedules

  5. Cold calls



 Warm leads always come first.



 Your scoreboard



 We will measure:



  - Speed to first call

  - Percentage of warm leads contacted

  - Total call attempts

  - Qualified appointments booked

  - Appointment show rate

  - Follow-up completion

  - CRM accuracy

  - Call quality

  - Daily communication



You will be expected to call every new warm lead during your shift, complete all scheduled follow-ups, and make cold calls whenever the warm-lead pipeline is current.



The initial activity target will be at least 60 total outbound call attempts per day when enough leads are available.



Appointment targets will be finalized after we measure actual lead volume, contact rates, and qualification rates.



Schedule and compensation



  - Part-time

  - Five hours per day

  - Monday through Friday

  - 25 hours per week

  - Fixed schedule during US Mountain Time business hours

  - $5–$6 USD per hour based on experience

  - Additional performance bonuses may be available for qualified appointments that attend

  - Opportunity for more hours and increased pay based on performance



  State your exact availability in US Mountain Time when applying.



  # You need



  - 1+ year of appointment setting, cold calling, phone sales, or SDR experience

  - Excellent spoken and written English

  - Clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation

  - Experience speaking with US prospects

  - Confidence on both warm and cold calls

  - The ability to sound natural instead of reading a script

  - Strong objection-handling skills

  - Experience using a CRM, dialer, calendar, SMS, and

  - Comfort using AI tools to work faster

  - Strong organization and follow-up discipline

  - A reliable computer and high-speed internet

  - A professional headset with a clear microphone

  - A quiet place to make calls

  - Reliable availability during your complete shift

  - Clear daily communication



  Experience with home-service companies, local businesses, marketing agencies, or B2B sales is preferred.



  This is not a general virtual-assistant position. This is a phone-based sales role for someone who is comfortable

  calling leads, handling rejection, following up consistently, and asking directly for the appointment.



  Follow the application instructions exactly or your application will not be reviewed.

title: Full-Time Social Media & Ads Video Editor
description:
Kate Stone Prep is a U.S.-based college preparation and admissions company looking for a talented, fast, and highly organized full-time video editor to join our team.



This is not a marketing strategy position. Our internal team develops the strategy, messaging, concepts, and creative direction. Your job is to take our raw content and turn it into polished, professional video content quickly and consistently.





WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON



You'll edit content for:



- Instagram Reels and other short-form social content

- Meta/Instagram advertisements

- Talking-head educational videos

- Client/student stories and testimonials

- Workshops and live events

- Longer-form educational content

- Multiple variations of advertising creative



A major part of this role is creating different versions of the same content.



For example, we may give you raw footage for one advertisement and ask you to create:



- A 60-second version

- A 30-second version

- A 15-second version

- Versions with different opening hooks

- Versions with different endings

- Versions combining different sections of the footage

- Different aspect ratios or formatting



We want to dramatically increase the amount of creative we're able to test without sacrificing quality.





EXPECTED VOLUME



Our initial goal is approximately 10 primary edited videos per week, plus additional versions and variations.



You'll be working with our team full-time, so your workload may vary from week to week depending on campaigns, events, and available footage.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should be:



- Excellent at short-form social video editing

- Comfortable editing paid social advertisements

- Very fast without becoming sloppy

- Excellent at following detailed instructions

- Able to reproduce an editing style from reference examples

- Strong with captions, pacing, music, B-roll, audio, and basic visual effects

- Comfortable creating many variations of the same creative

- Highly organized with files, folders, naming conventions, and versions

- Comfortable working through Google Drive

- A strong English communicator

- Reliable and responsive

- Interested in a long-term position



Experience with CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro is preferred.



Basic Canva and graphic-design skills are a plus, although advanced graphic design is not required.





SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



We are based in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States. We do not require you to work the entire U.S. workday, but we need dependable daily overlap with our team and fast communication and turnaround.



Our goal is generally 24-48-hour turnaround on editing assignments.





COMPENSATION



$1,000-$1,500 USD/month depending on experience and ability.

title: OPERATIONS/SYSTEMS MANAGER
description:
Role Summary

JNK Online Coaching is a Canadian based online fitness and nutrition coaching business serving women in perimenopause and menopause, with a team of roughly 16-18 people (coaches, closers, and ops/data support). 



We're looking for a Systems Ops Manager to own our tech stack end-to-end: GoHighLevel (GHL) administration, integrations across our tools (Stripe, Whop, Trainerize, SendGrid, AEvent, and Zoom), payment and client-status tracking, ad tracking/attribution insight, and the automations that keep client data accurate without manual re-entry. 



This is a builder/operator role, not an executive-assistant or reporting-only role — you'll be inside the software fixing and building, not managing a calendar. 



We want someone excellent at this specific work, full-time or near full-time, not a generalist splitting time across unrelated tasks.



Key Responsibilities



GoHighLevel administration



• Build, maintain, and QA automations/workflows, pipelines, calendars, and custom fields

• Fix broken automations before they cost us clients or revenue

• Be the go-to person for the team's questions, concerns, and issues around automations and systems

Integrations

• Keep data flowing correctly between GHL, Stripe, Whop, Trainerize, SendGrid, AEvent, and Zoom

• Eliminate manual re-entry between tools

• Support ad tracking and attribution (Meta ads, UTM parameters, pixel setup) so ad performance data ties cleanly into GHL and our reporting

Payment and client-status tracking

• Own subscription status, renewal/end dates, failed or declined payments inside GHL

• Build a reliable process for reconciling e-transfer payments (which don't auto-trigger like Stripe/Whop)

• Flag payment issues before they become client-retention issues

Client lifecycle tracking

• Replace our manual Google Sheet tracker with GHL-based tracking for onboarding, active status, renewals, and cancellations

• Ensure coach-client matching and status data stays accurate and current

• Where a Google Sheet is still the right tool for something, build and maintain the automations needed to keep it accurate (e.g., via Zapier/Make/App Script) instead of relying on manual updates

Reporting

• Produce clean, reliable reporting on show rates, close rates, retention, and coach performance — pulled from the system, not manually compiled

Systems judgment

• Recommend and, where approved, implement supporting automation only when GHL and Google Sheets automations genuinely can't do the job — without creating duplicate sources of truth

Must-Have Skills & Experience

• 2+ years hands-on building automations/workflows in GoHighLevel (not just using it as a basic CRM) — able to describe specific workflows built, not just "experience with GHL"

• Comfortable working across Stripe, Whop, and payment reconciliation (understands subscriptions, failed payments, chargebacks)

• Strong with Zapier or Make for connecting tools that don't integrate natively

• Detail-oriented and process-driven — this person catches the automation that silently broke three weeks ago

• Clear written English for documenting SOPs and communicating issues to the team

• Available to overlap with Manitoba business hours (America/Winnipeg, UTC-05:00) for at least part of the day

Nice-to-Have

• Familiarity with Trainerize, SendGrid, AEvent, or Zoom integrations

• Experience with Meta Ads tracking/attribution (Pixel, UTM parameters, conversion tracking)

• Prior experience in a coaching, fitness, or subscription/membership business

• Basic data reporting/visualization skills (dashboards, simple analysis)

• Experience training or documenting processes for a non-technical team

How Success Is Measured

• Zero client-affecting payment/automation failures per month (or issues caught and fixed before they reach a client)

• Client status, payment status, and end dates are always accurate in GHL — no more manual Google Sheet cross-checking

• Automations are documented, so the business isn't dependent on this one person's memory

• Reporting (show rates, close rates, retention, coach performance) is available on request without a manual scramble
