title: Part-Time VA – Content Direction, Editing & Pinterest for Plant Shop
description:
About Us



Nature House is a home-based plant shop based in Tucson, Arizona, selling rare and tropical houseplants, specialty substrates, and plant accessories through our Shopify store (
), with local pickup and nationwide shipping. Our brand voice is warm, beginner-friendly, and eco-conscious — "Greenery for Your Home, Calm for Your Soul." I run this business solo and I'm looking for a part-time VA to help me create better content and grow a new Pinterest presence.



I'm not very marketing-savvy myself, so I'm looking for someone who can guide me — suggest what's worth shooting and why, explain what's working, and help me build better habits around content, not just execute a list of instructions I hand you.



What You'll Do

Content direction: Guide me on what to shoot each week — specific, easy-to-follow photo/video ideas based on what's trending or performs well on Instagram, TikTok,
, and Pinterest (e.g., "a 15-second clip unboxing a new plant shipment," "a close-up photo of new substrate texture"). I'm new to marketing, so please explain the "why" behind suggestions in simple terms, not just a list of tasks. This includes helping me promote newer parts of the business, like my plant care services (plant sitting, rehab, repotting), local delivery option, and monthly craft fair appearances.

Editing: Take the raw photos/videos I shoot and edit them into finished posts/reels for each platform

Captions & hashtags: Write engaging, on-brand captions and research relevant hashtags for each post

Pinterest: Set up our Pinterest business account from scratch — boards, pin design, and an ongoing pinning strategy to drive traffic to our website

Website upkeep: Periodically update product listings, descriptions, and photos on our Shopify store, with basic SEO best practices in mind (keywords, alt text, etc.)



What This Role Does NOT Include (for now)

Posting/scheduling content live (I'll handle that)

Responding to comments/DMs (I'll handle that)



A Note on Tone

We're going for authentic and relatable, not polished/corporate. Think "helpful plant friend," not "brand voice." Please don't lean on AI-generated captions or overly generic stock phrasing (e.g., "Elevate your space," "Discover the beauty of...") — we want this to sound like a real person who loves plants, talking to a friend who's just getting into them.



Requirements

Experience editing social media content (reels, short-form video, photo editing) — please share examples/portfolio

Understanding of what performs well on Instagram, TikTok,
, and Pinterest

Comfortable proposing content ideas and explaining your reasoning — I'm new to marketing and want a guide, not just someone who takes instructions

Strong, natural written English for captions — casual and warm, not stiff or generic

Shopify experience a plus, including basic SEO knowledge (or willingness to learn)

Reliable internet, self-motivated, works well async

Hours & Pay

10–12 hours/week, flexible schedule (async — no fixed overlap required)

Pay: $5–7/hour depending on experience (paid monthly), starting with a 2–4 week trial period

Potential to grow into more hours/responsibility as the business grows

To Apply



Please send:



A brief intro

2–3 examples of social content you've edited or directed

Your availability/hours per week



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to edit a short sample clip/photo I provide, followed by a brief video call before starting a 2–4 week paid trial.

title: Part-Time Business Development Representative / Cold Caller
description:
Clearview Real Estate Media is looking for a confident, friendly, and highly fluent English-speaking Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our team.



Your primary responsibility will be making outbound calls to real estate agents, brokerages, home builders, and other potential clients in the United States.



This is NOT a data entry position.



We are looking for someone who enjoys talking to people, can confidently hold a conversation in English, handles rejection professionally, and is comfortable making outbound calls every day.



You will be provided with prospect lists, scripts, training, systems, and guidance.



What You'll Be Doing



Make outbound cold calls

Call and reactivate previous warm leads

Call real estate agents with active listings

Call agents with listings that have been on the market 60+ days

Call home builders

Call real estate brokerages

Follow up with interested prospects

Ask qualifying questions

Introduce Clearview's services and approved offers

Book complimentary media shoots

Schedule discovery calls

Follow up with prospects who aren't ready yet

Maintain accurate notes and follow-up dates

Update our 
 client acquisition pipeline

Book approved shoots through HDPhotoHub



You will NOT be responsible for building large prospect lists from scratch. Our team will provide qualified lead lists so you can focus primarily on calling, conversations, follow-up, and booking opportunities.



*Compensation is hourly, however bonuses are available



This means your earning potential increases when the clients you bring to Clearview become paying and repeat customers.

There is also opportunity for additional hours, increased compensation, and greater responsibility based on performance and company growth.



Who We're Looking For



You should have:

Excellent spoken English

Strong conversational English

Clear pronunciation

Confidence speaking with American business owners and professionals

Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, BDR, SDR, or sales experience

Strong listening skills

Ability to think and respond naturally instead of simply reading a script

Comfortable handling objections

Positive and professional personality

Strong follow-up habits

Good organization

Reliable internet connection

Quiet professional calling environment

Reliable computer and headset

Ability to work independently

Ability to follow scripts, SOPs, and processes

Experience calling U.S. real estate professionals is a major plus, but not required.



You Are Probably NOT a Good Fit If:



You dislike making phone calls

You are uncomfortable with rejection

You prefer data entry or administrative work

You frequently miss work or arrive late

You need constant supervision

You are uncomfortable speaking English for several hours

You simply read scripts word-for-word without having a real conversation

You are afraid to ask prospects questions

You don't consistently follow up



Systems We Use



You will receive training on our systems, including:



Google Sheets

HDPhotoHub

Slack

Our calling scripts and SOPs



What Success Looks Like



We are not looking for someone who simply makes hundreds of calls.



We want someone who can:

Start conversations → Build rapport → Identify opportunities → Follow up → Book appointments → Create new clients

Quality conversations and qualified opportunities matter more than rushing through calls.



REQUIRED VOICE RECORDING



If you are chosen, you will need to submit a 60-90 second voice recording introducing yourself and answering this question:



"Why do you believe you would be successful cold calling real estate agents in the United States?"



Please speak naturally. Do not read a prepared AI-generated answer.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Final Application Question



At the very end of your application, write:



CLEARVIEW BDR



This lets us know you carefully read the entire job posting.



About Clearview



Clearview Real Estate Media provides professional photography, video, social media reels, drone media, 3D tours, floor plans, and marketing services to real estate professionals.



We're building a long-term team and are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company.



If you're confident on the phone, enjoy sales, communicate extremely well in English, and love turning conversations into opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.

 rental, housing, neighborhood, and community groups.

Excellent written communication.

Reliable internet connection and computer access.

Comfortable using
, email, spreadsheets, shared documents, and online listing platforms.

 groups for marketing a rental property. Include the types of search terms you would use, how you would determine whether a group is active, and how you would track where each property was posted.

Please do not submit a generic or fully AI-generated response. We are looking for clear, natural answers that demonstrate your personal thinking, attention to detail, and ability to follow instructions. Applicants may be asked to explain their answers during an interview.

False statements or nondisclosure may result in immediate disqualification. If discovered after hiring, they may result in termination of employment or the working relationship, subject to applicable law and contractual terms.

* Create and maintain rental listings through our AppFolio leasing portal.

* Promote available properties in
 groups—a major part of this role.

* Screen and qualify applicants using our established criteria.

Position 2: Real Estate Administrative Assistant



You will help keep property bills, expenses, and payment records accurate, organized, and current.



Responsibilities include:



* Review and reconcile water bills, property tax bills, vendor invoices, HOA dues, and insurance payments.

* Identify incorrect charges, discrepancies, duplicate charges, and overdue balances.

* Investigate and dispute billing errors, following through until resolved.

* Communicate with vendors, utility providers, and other relevant organizations to resolve issues.

* Track due dates, payment status, and outstanding issues using software or spreadsheets.

* Maintain organized invoices, statements, payment confirmations, and supporting records.

* Flag upcoming deadlines and items requiring management’s attention.



This role suits someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable reviewing numbers (little to no math required), and persistent about resolving discrepancies.



What We’re Looking For



* Strong written and spoken English.

* Excellent organization and attention to detail.

* Reliable follow-through and clear communication.

title: CRO Shopify
description:
At Lantern Sol, we’re a dynamic, multicultural team of developers, designers, project managers, and SEO experts dedicated to building exceptional e-commerce websites on Shopify. Shape the future of commerce – Your work will directly impact businesses worldwide.

Flexible work environment – Work from anywhere, set your own schedule.

Join a thriving global team – Collaborate with top talent across multiple time zones.

Professional growth – Stay ahead with continuous learning opportunities and challenging projects.

Lantern Sol is looking for a part-time CRO Specialist to support our Shopify and eCommerce clients. This person will provide the deeper CRO expertise behind each account.



They will analyze customer and website data, develop testing hypotheses, guide experiment planning, evaluate results, and help communicate the business impact of the work to clients.

Each account will still have a Lantern Sol project manager responsible for the overall relationship, timelines, and coordination. Our internal design and development teams will handle execution. The CRO Specialist will own the strategy, analysis, and interpretation that guide the work.

What You’ll Do



Complete initial CRO audits using data from GA4, Shopify, testing platforms, heatmaps, session recordings, and other available sources.

Compare data across platforms to identify conversion issues, customer behavior patterns, and areas of opportunity.

Participate in recurring ideation sessions with project managers, designers, and developers.

Turn findings and ideas into clear, testable hypotheses.

Build and prioritize testing plans based on potential impact, available traffic, confidence, and level of effort.

Recommend an appropriate testing cadence for each client rather than applying the same process to every account.

Plan tests across different areas of the customer journey, such as the homepage, navigation, product pages, cart, and checkout.

Help structure simultaneous tests appropriately so results remain accurate and clients are not exposed to conflicting experiments.

Define the audience, success metrics, and measurement approach for each test.

Review experiment results and determine whether a hypothesis was confirmed, denied, or requires another iteration.

Translate both positive and negative test results into useful insights and clear next steps.

Estimate the potential business impact of test results using conversion rate, traffic, average order value, and projected revenue.

Update client reporting with results, screenshots, findings, and recommendations.

Join client calls when needed to explain testing strategy or present results.

Help Lantern Sol improve and document a consistent CRO process that can scale across accounts.

Use AI tools to support analysis, ideation, and reporting while applying independent judgment to the final recommendations.

You’re a Great Fit If You…

Have hands-on experience as a CRO strategist or specialist for Shopify, D2C, or eCommerce brands supporting multiple CRO clients.

Experience with Intelligems or similar Shopify experimentation platforms, creating and evaluating A/B or split tests.

Understand testing methodology, audience segmentation, sample size, statistical significance, and common factors that can make results unreliable.

Can work across GA4, Shopify Analytics, and CRO testing platforms to build a more complete view of performance.

Know how to turn data into focused hypotheses and practical testing plans.

Can prioritize several testing opportunities without running overlapping experiments that compromise the results.

Experience creating or presenting client-facing CRO reports: You know how to frame an unsuccessful experiment as a useful learning rather than simply reporting it as a loss.

Can explain data and testing results clearly to clients and team members who may not have a CRO background.

Are comfortable collaborating with project managers, designers, and developers without needing to manage the entire account.

Are organized, responsive, and able to support multiple accounts in a remote agency environment.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Figma and design-to-development workflows.

Experience helping an agency build or standardize its CRO delivery process.

title: Video Editors (Long-Term + Growing US Agency)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.



About Us



Vantage Point Agency is a growing US-based digital marketing and creative agency. We have served 50+ clients and are looking for a team of video editors not a one-time freelancer.



We want someone who wants to grow with us, improve their skills, and eventually take greater leadership within our creative team of editors.



The Role



We are looking for a highly skilled, dependable, and creative Video Editor who understands storytelling not just how to cut videos.



Our team produces approximately 80–100 pieces of quality video content every month, including:



* Reels, TikToks & YouTube Shorts

* Long-form YouTube videos

* Full podcast episodes & podcast clips

* Reaction videos

* Talking-head content

* Quote/text-based videos

* Promotional & brand storytelling content



Technical Skills — REQUIRED



You must be comfortable with:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* CapCut for fast-paced and short-form editing workflows

* Professional color correction & color grading

* Editing footage captured on Sony cinematic cameras

* Working with LOG/flat footage and creating a polished final look

* 4K editing and exports

* Audio cleanup and mixing

* Captions and on-screen graphics

* B-roll and visual storytelling

* Music and sound design

* Short-form AND long-form editing

* Vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) formats

* Google Drive file organization

*

Premiere Pro is our primary professional editing platform, but we also value editors who know how to use CapCut efficiently when it makes sense for short-form content and faster workflows.



We will provide access to Epidemic Sound for professional music and sound effects.



### Storytelling Matters



We don't want editors who simply cut clips and add captions. You should understand pacing, emotion, B-roll, music, hooks, sound design, and visual storytelling.



Because our clients are primarily US-based, you must also understand how to select accurate US-based B-roll and visuals. If someone is talking about Tampa, show Tampa FL. If they're talking about American football, don't show soccer.



If you don't understand a reference, research it before choosing the footage.



Quality Is Non-Negotiable



Our goal isn't simply to produce 80–100 videos.



It's to have 80–100 QUALITY pieces of content ready every month.



Before a video reaches our leadership team or a client, it should have:



* No typos

* No caption mistakes

* No obvious editing errors

* Accurate B-roll

* Professional color grading

* Clean audio

* Correct branding

* Correct formatting and exports

* Strong pacing and storytelling



Growth & Leadership



We want someone who is hungry to get better.



You should be willing to learn new editing styles, advanced Premiere Pro and CapCut techniques, AI tools, and emerging creative technology.



We don't want you doing the exact same type of editing a year from now.



As you grow, there is an opportunity to help lead our editing team, review other editors' work, maintain quality, manage deadlines, and make sure every editor knows what they are responsible for.



Video Editor → Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Team Leader



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



This position requires an experienced video editor. Please do not apply if:



* You only know basic video cuts and captions.

* You do not know how to color correct and color grade video.

* You are not comfortable editing 4K footage from Sony cinematic cameras.

* You do not understand storytelling, pacing, and how to keep viewers watching.

* You use random B-roll instead of choosing footage that matches what the person is saying.

* You often miss spelling mistakes, caption errors, or other small details.

* You need step-by-step instructions for every video.

* You are not willing to learn and improve your skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, AI tools, and new editing technology.

* You cannot study a reference video and create something with a similar style and level of quality.



We do not expect you to know everything. But we do expect you to learn, improve, solve problems, and become a better editor over time.

title: Funnel Builder - Dropshipping - Health Beauty Niche

Nice to Have

Experience with WeTracked

Experience in Dropshipping or high-volume direct-response e-commerce

Experience in the Health & Beauty niche



What We Offer

Long-term opportunity with competitive compensation based on experience

Stable workload with clear briefs and processes

Room for growth and increased responsibility over time



To Apply

One prompt you use regularly in your own workflow, and what it does for you

title: Executive Assistant + HR Manager (Philippines) — Confidential Search, Long-Term Role
description:
About This Role



This is a confidential search. We are an established US-owned company with an existing Philippines-based

remote team, and we have been named a Great Place to Work in the past. We are not naming the company in

this posting. Shortlisted candidates will be told exactly who we are before any

interview, and we will answer every question you have about the business at that stage.



We need one person wearing two hats: half the week supporting our owners and senior leaders as

an Executive Assistant, and half the week running HR operations for our Philippines team.



Neither half is a full-time job on its own. Together, they are. That is the honest shape of this

role — and it is why we need someone senior enough to switch between the two without dropping

either one.



You must have real, demonstrable experience in BOTH areas. Applications with only EA experience

or only HR experience will not be considered.



---



Hat #1 — Executive Assistant (roughly 50%)



Supporting 1–2 executives:



- Calendar and meeting management

- Inbox triage, follow-ups, and prioritization

- Preparing summaries, documents, agendas, and internal reports

- Tracking commitments across the leadership team and chasing them to done

- Coordinating across teams and time zones

- Using tools, systems, and AI to give the executives their time back

- Thinking one step ahead — finding the task before it is assigned to you



Hat #2 — HR Manager (roughly 50%)



Running people operations for our Philippines-based team:



- Payroll coordination, payroll filings, and payment processing

- Maxicare enrollment, payments, and day-to-day administration

- HR documentation and personnel records

- Compliance with Philippine labor rules and best practice

- Hiring support, onboarding, and offboarding

- Serving as the HR point of contact for team members

- Tracking attendance and time, and surfacing issues early

- Protecting and building on a culture we have already been recognized for



This role sees confidential information — compensation, performance, personal records.

Discretion is not a nice-to-have. It is the job.



---



Attendance and Availability — Read This Carefully



We are direct about this because it matters more to us than any other single line in this post.



- This role works US business hours.

- This role must be reliably online and reachable during those hours. Executives and team

  members depend on you being there.

- If you cannot commit to a consistent, predictable schedule, please do not apply.

- Time off is expected and supported. Unplanned absences without notice are not.

- We will ask about your attendance record in prior roles, and we will ask your references about

  it specifically.



---



Required Experience (all of these)



- Prior experience as an Executive Assistant supporting senior leaders or owners. Proven success supporting executives with proactive processes is very important to us.

- Prior experience as an HR Manager or HR Lead in the Philippines. You will be an advocate for the culture so we need someone who can exhibit our culture with the team and build strong relationships internally.

- Working knowledge of PH labor rules, payroll, statutory filings, and benefits administration

- Hands-on experience with Maxicare or a comparable HMO — enrollment, billing, member issues

- Excellent written and spoken English

- High discretion and professionalism with confidential information

- Able to work independently, set your own priorities, and follow through without being chased

- Reliable internet, a working backup connection, and a quiet place to work

- Curiosity about AI and technology, and a track record of using it to work faster



 Expectations



- Experience supporting founders, owners, or C-level executives

- Experience with remote teams or call center / BPO environments

- Familiarity with AI and automation tools

- A record of improving systems and processes, not just running them

- Culture-building or employee-engagement experience



---



What You Get



- A seat at a company named a Great Place to Work — this is a culture people stay in, and you

  will be one of the people responsible for keeping it that way

- Long-term, stable role — we are hiring for years, not months

- Direct access to company ownership and senior leadership

- Real ownership of HR for the Philippines team

- Exposure across the whole business — this is a growth seat for the right person

- Remote, Philippines-based

- Standard benefits for the role

- Compensation is based on experience. We pay well for the right person, and we will discuss

  numbers openly once we know what you bring. Tell us your expected monthly rate in your

  application.



---



How to Apply — Follow Every Step



We screen on attention to detail first. Any application missing a step below will not be reviewed.



1. Start your cover letter with the exact phrase: Two Hats

2. A short cover letter covering your EA experience and your HR experience separately, and the

   concrete value you delivered in each

3. Your resume

4. Three specific examples of how you made an executive more efficient or improved an HR

   operation — with the actual result, not a description of the duty

5. The tools you have used: HR, payroll, HMO portals, productivity, AI

6. How you have used AI tools in a prior role — be specific about the task and the outcome

7. Your current availability, the hours you can work, and the date you could start

8. Your expected monthly rate

9. Optional but appreciated: a short video introduction



If you are detail-focused, curious, proactive, and you want a seat where your work is visible to

the people who run the company — follow the steps above exactly and send it in. Please do not submit an application if you don't meet the experience requirements or cannot provide the requested information.  



Thank you! We look forward to meeting the right person for this next career step.

title: AI Video Ad Creator + Performance Creative Strategist | Luxury B2B Product
description:
We are looking for a strong creative partner to help us develop and produce high-quality video ads for a premium physical product.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who understands that performance advertising is more than just making good-looking videos. We need someone who can develop strong ad concepts, understand what makes people stop scrolling, and turn those ideas into polished, credible video creatives that can perform on Meta.



Our product is sold in a B2B environment and needs to be positioned as a premium, high-end solution. The creative should feel professional, realistic, premium, and credible, not cheap, gimmicky, overly AI-generated, or like generic social media content.



What You'll Do

Develop original Meta ad concepts and creative angles

Understand hooks, messaging, pacing, and ad structure

Create realistic, premium video advertisements

Accurately present a physical product across different scenes and camera angles

Maintain consistent product proportions, dimensions, details, and appearance

Place the product convincingly into realistic environments

Create multiple variations for ongoing Meta creative testing

Understand the difference between attractive content and performance-driven advertising

Proactively bring new creative ideas to the team

Take concepts from idea to storyboard, production, and finished ad

Product Accuracy Is Extremely Important



We have seen visually impressive AI-generated videos where the product changes shape, proportions, size, or details from one shot to another. That will not work for us.



You should be comfortable using the right combination of:



AI video generation

AI image generation

CGI / 3D

Compositing

Video editing

Motion graphics

Other production techniques



The goal is to create strong advertising while keeping the actual product accurate and consistent throughout the creative.



Who We're Looking For



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions like:



"Tell me exactly what video you want me to make."



We want someone who can look at the product, target audience, and advertising objective and come back with:



"Here are the concepts I think we should test, here is why they could work, and here is how I would execute them."



You should have a strong understanding of:



Meta advertising

Performance creative

B2B marketing

Premium / luxury positioning

Physical product advertising

Creative testing

Commercial storytelling



Experience with real estate, property management, hospitality, architecture, construction, automotive, luxury products, or other B2B industries is a major plus.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are not looking for someone for just one video.



We want to build a long-term creative partnership where we continuously:



Develop → Produce → Test → Learn → Improve → Create new variations



For the right person, there will be consistent ongoing work.



To Apply | Portfolio Required



Please send your portfolio and your 3 to 5 most relevant examples of your work.



We specifically want to see:



3 to 5 of your best product-focused video ads

Examples of ads you created specifically for Meta,
, or Instagram

Examples involving premium/luxury products, B2B, real estate, physical products, or commercial advertising

At least one example showing consistent product appearance across multiple AI-generated shots, if available

A short explanation of how you develop ad concepts, not just how you produce the video

The AI tools, editing software, CGI/3D tools, and workflow you use

Your availability for ongoing work

Important



Please do not send a generic proposal or a large portfolio without identifying your most relevant work.



When applying, start your message with:



"CREATIVE TESTING"



Then include your portfolio link and briefly explain which projects in your portfolio are most relevant to this position.



We care about quality, professionalism, creative thinking, product accuracy, and performance.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term creative partner, not simply a video editor who executes instructions.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
Part-time | 20 hours per week | Monday through Friday | 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time



ABOUT THE ROLE

Lawn & Land Marketing is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency built specifically for lawn care and landscaping companies. We are hiring an experienced
 Ads Manager who can confidently manage Meta advertising for multiple client accounts from end to end.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is not a social media posting position. We need someone who has personally built, launched, tested, analyzed, and optimized paid
 and Instagram campaigns that generate real leads for service businesses.



The role starts part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position and a leadership role within our Meta Ads department based on performance, ownership, and team fit.



YOUR SCHEDULE

You must be available and actively working Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

For applicants in the Philippines, this is an overnight schedule:

- Approximately 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time while the U.S. is observing daylight-saving time

- Approximately 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine Time while the U.S. is observing standard time

The U.S. Eastern schedule is fixed, so your local hours will shift when U.S. daylight-saving time changes. Please apply only if you can reliably maintain this schedule year-round.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Build
 and Instagram campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager from campaign setup through launch

- Manage campaign, ad set, and ad-level settings accurately

- Build Meta Instant Forms with the correct questions, fields, privacy details, and completion steps

- Coordinate and verify lead routing into our CRM and automation systems

- Submit and verify test leads before campaigns go live

- Research audiences, offers, competitors, and local markets

- Write clear ad copy and calls to action for lawn care, landscaping, tree care, and outdoor-living services

- Create and evaluate static ad graphics that are accurate, polished, and appropriate for each client

- Use ChatGPT image generation and other AI tools to develop original creative concepts and usable campaign assets

- Catch visual problems such as incorrect equipment, unrealistic plants or properties, distorted text, bad anatomy, obvious AI artifacts, and service details that do not match the client

- Review every campaign end to end before launch, including copy, creative, links, forms, targeting, tracking, placements, schedule, and approved budget

- Monitor spend and performance during working hours

- Optimize campaigns using lead quality and business outcomes, not surface-level engagement metrics

- Test audiences, copy, creative, offers, placements, and form approaches with a clear reason for each test

- Report performance clearly, including spend, lead volume, cost per lead, click-through rate, frequency, conversion issues, lead quality, and recommended next actions

- Communicate blockers early and follow tasks through to a verified finish



WHAT WE REQUIRE

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience managing
 and Instagram ads

- Proven experience with lead-generation campaigns, not only awareness, boosted posts, or organic social media

- Experience managing multiple client ad accounts, preferably in an agency environment

- Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager, audiences, retargeting, placements, Instant Forms, pixels and datasets, events, and campaign quality assurance

- Ability to explain campaign decisions using actual performance data

- Strong graphic-design judgment and a portfolio of ads you personally created or directed

- Hands-on experience using ChatGPT for image generation, including prompting, iterating, correcting, and quality-checking outputs

- Understanding of visual accuracy. A polished image is not good enough if it shows the wrong service, equipment, property, season, or customer

- Experience connecting Meta leads to GoHighLevel or another CRM, or enough technical understanding to coordinate field mapping, automations, and end-to-end testing confidently

- Strong written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan for outages

- High attention to detail and the ability to follow written instructions completely

- Availability for the full 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time shift, Monday through Friday



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Experience generating leads for U.S. local-service or home-service businesses

- Experience with lawn care, landscaping, tree care, outdoor living, or another green-industry service

- Experience working in GoHighLevel

- Experience with Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Figma, or similar design software

- Familiarity with ChatGPT, automation tools, spreadsheets, reporting dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows

- Experience mentoring another media buyer or helping establish campaign standards and documented processes



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED

- Campaigns are built correctly and launched without preventable mistakes

- Leads reach the correct CRM workflow and are verified before launch

- Creative is accurate, brand-appropriate, and strong enough to stop attention

- Campaigns receive consistent, evidence-based optimization

- Lead quality and cost improve over time

- Reporting is accurate, useful, and tied to clear next actions

- Tasks are completed end to end without repeated reminders

- Problems are raised early, with a recommended solution



HOW WE WORK

We care about ownership, clear communication, and verified results. You will receive direction and standards, but we expect you to think, catch problems, and finish the job completely.

If something is unclear, ask before spending money or publishing the wrong thing. If something breaks, own it, explain it plainly, and bring a solution.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH

- Starting schedule: 20 hours per week

- Long-term remote position

- Opportunity to grow into full-time work and Meta department leadership based on demonstrated performance

- Final candidates will complete a short paid skills assessment using a realistic campaign scenario



HOW TO APPLY

Do not send a generic application through OnlineJobs.ph.



Complete the full application here:





The application includes detailed experience questions. After submitting the first step, you will be directed to a second page with instructions for a short Loom video.



Applications that do not follow both steps will not be reviewed.

title: Aftercare & Customer Support Virtual Assistant – Solar
description:
About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based solar company looking for a reliable, organized, and customer-focused Aftercare & Customer Support Virtual Assistant to take care of our customers after their solar installation is completed.



This role is focused on making sure customers continue to feel supported after the sale and installation — not just answering questions, but proactively following up, keeping customers informed, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You’ll be the friendly point of contact helping customers with post-installation communication, warranty information, follow-ups, reviews, referrals, and general aftercare.



If you are naturally organized, good at communicating with customers, comfortable making follow-up calls, and the type of person who remembers to follow through without being reminded, we’d love to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Customer Aftercare



Follow up with customers after their solar installation

Make sure customers have received their warranty documents and other important project information

Check in with customers to make sure everything is going well after installation

Answer customer questions through phone,
, and other communication channels

Provide friendly and professional support throughout the customer’s post-installation experience

Identify customer concerns and make sure they are routed to the appropriate team



Scheduled Customer Follow-Ups



Manage and complete scheduled customer touchpoints

Conduct approximately 30-day follow-ups when applicable

Maintain ongoing 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month customer check-ins

Keep accurate notes about every customer interaction

Make sure follow-ups are completed on time



Reviews & Referrals



Request customer reviews at the appropriate point in the customer journey

Follow up with customers regarding their experience

Identify satisfied customers who may be willing to refer friends or family

Help keep referral and review information organized

Communicate positive customer feedback to the team



Customer Portal / CRM



Keep customer records accurate and up to date

Enter notes and follow-up results into our systems

Track open customer issues and follow-ups

Upload or organize customer documents when needed

Monitor outstanding aftercare tasks and make sure they are completed



Issue Coordination



Listen carefully to customer concerns

Determine whether an issue needs to be escalated

Coordinate with the appropriate internal team when additional help is needed

Follow up with the customer after an issue has been handed off

Never let a customer issue disappear simply because it was passed to someone else

What We're Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is:



Excellent at communicating in English, both written and spoken

Warm, friendly, and professional with customers

Comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners by phone

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Strong at follow-up and task management

Comfortable working with multiple customers and deadlines

Proactive and able to work independently

Good at documenting conversations and keeping records accurate

Patient when dealing with frustrated or confused customers

Comfortable learning new software and processes

Reliable and consistent with attendance

Able to follow SOPs while also using good judgment when something falls outside the normal process

Experience



Required:



Previous customer service, virtual assistant, administrative, or BPO experience

Strong English communication skills

Experience communicating with customers by phone,
, chat, or SMS

Comfortable using Google Workspace and learning new systems



Preferred:



Solar industry experience

Home services, construction, HVAC, roofing, or similar experience

CRM experience

Experience with customer retention or after-sales support

Experience requesting reviews or referrals

Experience managing customer follow-up schedules



Solar experience is NOT required. We can train the right person on our systems and processes.



Hours & Compensation



Pay: $5–$6 USD/hour depending on experience



Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week



Work arrangement: Remote / Independent Contractor



Time zone: Must be available to work U.S. business hours as required by the team.



This is intended to be a long-term position for someone who wants to grow with the company.



The Person We're Looking For



You might be a great fit if you are the person who:



Notices when a customer hasn't received a response

Follows up without being asked

Keeps detailed notes

Doesn't lose track of open tasks

Can handle a difficult customer calmly

Takes ownership instead of simply saying, "That's not my job"

Enjoys helping people and creating a great customer experience

Can follow a process but also knows when something needs to be escalated



This is not just a data-entry position. Your communication, judgment, organization, and ability to follow through are very important to this role.



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Please complete our official application form to be considered for this position.



Application Form:





Please include your updated resume and complete all required information in the application.



Incomplete applications may not be considered.



Please do not send direct/private messages regarding this position. Direct PMs will not be entertained.



All applicants must apply through the official application form provided above.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

* Create dashboards for event management, staffing, scheduling, contracts, and client communication.

* Integrate our CRM, calendars, email, project management, and communication tools.

* Build AI assistants that can answer questions using our internal documentation.

* Create proposal generators, pricing calculators, onboarding systems, and workflow automations.

* Optimize repetitive administrative tasks using AI.

* Recommend and implement the best AI tools as new technology becomes available.

* Continuously improve our internal systems through automation and AI.



---



## Required Skills



We're looking for someone who already builds with modern AI tools—not someone just beginning to learn them.



Experience with:

title: Remote Invoicer (Philippines, supporting U.S. operations) - 3 openings
description:

Who we are



CB Direct is a U.S. fleet hardware service company. Since 2015 we have installed and serviced GPS trackers, dash cameras and telematics devices in commercial vehicles across the United States. Every completed job has to be billed correctly and quickly. That is this role.





The role



You will turn completed field jobs into accurate invoices, every day, at volume. An invoice here means reading the completed work order in Salesforce, confirming the job sheet, parts and notes support what we are billing, building the invoice in QuickBooks, sending it to the customer or submitting it through their portal, and closing the loop in Salesforce.



This is high-volume, repetitive work where accuracy is the whole job. Our invoicers process at least 30 invoices a day from start to finish, and a wrong invoice costs more than a slow one. If you like clearing a queue, catching the detail everyone else missed, and finishing the day with nothing left open, you will do well here.



You start with CB Direct orientation and scheduler fundamentals so you understand how our work gets done, then move to invoicing training with the Invoicing Team.





What you will do



-Review completed work orders and supporting information in Salesforce

-Verify the information needed for billing is complete and matches the job sheet

-Create and process invoices in QuickBooks

-Send invoices to customers, including through customer billing portals where the account requires it

-Update Salesforce once each invoice is complete and close the work order

-Spot missing or wrong information and chase it to resolution

-Flag early when something is blocking an invoice instead of letting it sit

-Follow the billing procedure for each customer account exactly

-Hit the daily volume while keeping accuracy high





What we are looking for



We hire the top 5% of applicants, not the qualified ones. Strong candidates can point to specific examples of:

Billing or invoicing experience - you have created and sent invoices at volume, ideally against work orders or job records

Attention to detail - dates, quantities, part numbers, rates and customer names are right the first time

Speed with accuracy - you can show a daily number you sustained and an error rate you kept low

Working the exception - you found the missing piece, asked the right person, and got the invoice out

Time management - you manage your own queue and finish the day with the work done

Communication - clear written and spoken English for internal check-ins and customer billing questions

AI fluency - you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar as part of how you work. We use Claude daily. Claude experience is preferred.

Tools - QuickBooks, Salesforce and customer billing portals (Coupa, Ariba or similar) are a plus; what matters more is how fast you pick up new systems





Requirements



Fluent, professional written and spoken English

Comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work and a daily productivity standard

Full availability for a fixed Monday to Friday shift within 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central, working exclusively for us

Camera on for team check-ins and training

Reliable computer with a second monitor, stable high-speed internet with a backup, headset and webcam

Able to start training the week of September 28 or the week after





How to apply



Put "Golden Circle" in the subject line so we know you read the whole post. Applications without it are not reviewed.

In your application, answer these three:



1. Where you did billing or invoicing, what systems you used, and your typical daily volume

title: Commercial Real Estate Transaction Coordinator
description:
MUST PROVIDE RESUME AND VOICE SAMPLE TO BE CONSIDERED



We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Commercial Real Estate Client & Transaction Coordinator to support our brokerage team throughout the entire client and transaction lifecycle.



This individual will help move prospective clients from initial consultation to signed representation agreement, organize client documents, coordinate property inquiries, track proposals and contracts, and ensure consistent follow-up with clients, brokers, referral partners, and other transaction parties.



The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who takes ownership of deadlines, follows up consistently, maintains accurate records, and ensures that no client, property inquiry, proposal, or transaction falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities



Client Onboarding

- Track prospective clients who need to sign a brokerage, buyer representation, tenant representation, listing, confidentiality, or other client agreement.

- Send agreements to clients for electronic signature after receiving approval from the broker.

- Follow up with clients until all required agreements are signed.

- Confirm that agreements are properly completed, signed, dated, and saved.

- Create an electronic file for every new client.

- Notify the team lead  when a client has completed the onboarding process.

- Maintain a list of clients with unsigned or incomplete agreements.



Client Document Collection

- Create a document checklist for each client based on the type of assignment.

- Request required information and documents from clients

- Follow up with clients regarding missing or incomplete documents.

- Organize and properly label all documents in the appropriate electronic folders.

- Maintain confidentiality when handling personal, business, and financial information.



Property Search Follow-Up

- Maintain an organized tracker of properties sent to each client.

- Record client feedback in the property tracker.

- Send reminders when clients have not responded to property recommendations.

- Provide the team lead with a summary of client feedback and requested next steps.

- Ensure promising properties receive timely follow-up.



Property Inquiries

- Maintain a record of every property inquiry and response.

- Follow up with listing brokers who have not responded.

- Save property documents and broker correspondence in the appropriate client or property folder.

- Escalate time-sensitive opportunities or important property information to the team lead.



Proposals, LOIs and Contracts

- Maintain a tracker for proposals, letters of intent, purchase agreements, leases, listing agreements, amendments, and other transaction documents.

- Follow up with clients and cooperating brokers regarding outstanding proposals and contracts.

- Track when documents were sent, received, revised, accepted, rejected, or countered.

- Save executed documents in the correct transaction folder.

- Notify the team of pending deadlines, unanswered proposals, requested revisions, and outstanding signatures.

- Follow up regularly until each proposal or contract is resolved.



Referral Agreement Management

- Prepare referral agreements using approved company templates.

- Follow up until the referral agreement is signed by all parties.

- Save fully executed referral agreements in the appropriate client and transaction files.



Required Qualifications

- At least two years of experience in real estate coordination, transaction management,brokerage support, or a similar position.

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based real estate company is strongly preferred.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong follow-up, organization, and deadline-management skills.

- Ability to communicate professionally with clients and commercial real estate brokers.

- Ability to manage multiple clients, properties, proposals, and transactions simultaneously.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and backup internet or power arrangements.

- Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Preferred Qualifications

- Commercial real estate experience.

- Familiarity with land, industrial, office, retail, and commercial leasing transactions.

- Experience with Follow Up Boss, Launchbay, Google Sheets, DocuSign, CoStar, or Crexi.

title: WFH Client Account Manager — US Clients | PH Morning Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Resident Services & Maintenance Operations Specialist
description:
About ParkNation

ParkNation invests in, manages, and operates manufactured housing and RV communities across Texas and California. We are building a centralized, function-based operations team — specialized remote roles working hand-in-hand with on-site field teams, Rent Manager workflows, and automation. Building Communities. Creating Opportunities. Improving Lives.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced U.S. property-management professional to become the primary remote point of contact for existing residents — owning resident communications, retention, lease renewals, maintenance intake, Service Order dispatch, and follow-through across multiple communities. Field teams handle on-site work; you own the systems, documentation, and accountability around it.

What You'll Do

• Serve as primary point of contact for residents via phone, text,
, and portal

• Research resident accounts and history in Rent Manager; resolve issues remotely when possible

• Identify retention risks and coordinate follow-up before move-outs occur

• Manage the full lease-renewal pipeline — notices, documentation, e-signatures, Rent Manager records

• Receive and triage maintenance requests; create and manage Service Orders in Rent Manager

• Dispatch field personnel and vendors, track work to completion, and verify closeout with residents

• Coordinate vendor quotes, purchase orders, and invoice review against approved scope

• Support resident portal adoption and general community communications

Rent Manager Experience — Required

This is a Rent Manager-intensive position. In-depth, hands-on Rent Manager experience is a must-have, not a preference. Candidates without demonstrated Rent Manager experience will not be considered.

Requirements

• 4+ years U.S. residential property-management experience (multifamily, MH, RV, or SFR)

• Strong resident-services, retention, and lease-renewal experience

• Maintenance dispatch / work-order management experience

• Excellent spoken and written English and phone presence

• Strong documentation discipline and follow-through

• Reliable high-speed internet, dependable computer, quality headset

What This Pay Range Expects From You

At $8-$10/hour, this offer sits well above the typical remote VA rate — we're hiring for seniority and ownership, not entry-level task execution. We expect:

• In-depth, hands-on Rent Manager mastery — not just general PMS familiarity

• Full-time exclusive commitment to this role (no concurrent clients/jobs)

• Stable work history with minimal gaps or job-hopping

• Ability to independently own a resident-facing book of business with minimal oversight

• A quiet, dedicated home-office setup suited to a U.S.-facing, phone-heavy role

Why Join ParkNation

You'll be a true member of ParkNation's Centralized Operations Team — not a generic VA — directly impacting resident satisfaction, retention, and maintenance performance across a growing portfolio.



To ensure you read the entire JD, Please start with "Hello ParkNation Team".
